item.g:title: Prism Handheld Pieces Modular Hydro-filtration Device Percolators - Big Showerhead / Clear
item.g:description: Looking to change the functionality of your custom hydro-filtration device? The Prism Handheld Pieces Replacement Percolator is the perfect solution! The Halo Connectors on our Custom Hydro-filtration Devices, and all pre-built hydro-vessels from Prism Handheld Pieces, are equipped with patented Halo Connectors that allow you to seamlessly swap parts and add new accessories, including any number of these glass percolators. You’ll need at least two Halo Connectors to add a glass percolator to any modular custom hydro-filtration device or Prism Handheld Pieces hydro-vessel (one to connect to the Key features: base and one to screw in the mouthpiece ). There are two types of modular hydro-filtration device percolators from Prism Handheld Pieces, showerhead and tree. Each replacement perc is available in two sizes, standard or big, and the specifications of each are listed below.; The Showerhead Percolator is an ideal choice for adding filtration and additional features to your Custom Hydro-filtration Device. A showerhead percolator is a type of percolator found in hydro-filtration devices that resembles a showerhead. It consists of a tube with holes or slits at the bottom that flares outwards, allowing aroma to be filtered and cooled before inhalation. Showerhead percolators are one of the most popular types of percs found in hydro-filtration devices due to their simple design and ability to provide effective filtration. Constructed with thin slits to ensure maximum airflow, the Prism Handheld Pieces Showerhead Percolator distributes your aroma evenly throughout its chamber while you pull for ultra-smooth draws. The Big Showerhead Percolator operates the same way while adding a bit more size and volume to your hydro-filtration device.; Incorporating a Prism Handheld Pieces Tree Percolator into your modular hydro-vessel will add a ton of filtration to each draw and put on a show while doing so. A tree percolator is a specific type of percolator that consists of a central tube that runs up through the body of the hydro-filtration device, with multiple arms extending down from the top like the branches of a tree. These arms are equipped with small slits or holes at the bottom that allow the aroma to diffuse and cool down as it passes through the water in the chamber. This results in smoother, more enjoyable aroma. With a tree percolator, you can expect less harsh draws and better filtration of impurities. The Big Tree Percolator belongs in a class all on its own, featuring a 12-arm perc that will elevate your custom hydro-filtration device in a big way.; Product Specs:. Category: Accessories. Brand: Prism Pipes.

The Halo Connectors on our Custom Hydro-filtration Devices, and all pre-built hydro-vessels from Prism Handheld Pieces, are equipped with patented Halo Connectors that allow you to seamlessly swap parts and add new accessories, including any number of these glass percolators. You’ll need at least two Halo Connectors to add a glass percolator to any modular custom hydro-filtration device or Prism Handheld Pieces hydro-vessel (one to connect to the Key features: base and one to screw in the mouthpiece ). There are two types of modular hydro-filtration device percolators from Prism Handheld Pieces, showerhead and tree. Each replacement perc is available in two sizes, standard or big, and the specifications of each are listed below.; The Showerhead Percolator is an ideal choice for adding filtration and additional features to your Custom Hydro-filtration Device. A showerhead percolator is a type of percolator found in hydro-filtration devices that resembles a showerhead. It consists of a tube with holes or slits at the bottom that flares outwards, allowing aroma to be filtered and cooled before inhalation. Showerhead percolators are one of the most popular types of percs found in hydro-filtration devices due to their simple design and ability to provide effective filtration. Constructed with thin slits to ensure maximum airflow, the Prism Handheld Pieces Showerhead Percolator distributes your aroma evenly throughout its chamber while you pull for ultra-smooth draws. The Big Showerhead Percolator operates the same way while adding a bit more size and volume to your hydro-filtration device.; Incorporating a Prism Handheld Pieces Tree Percolator into your modular hydro-vessel will add a ton of filtration to each draw and put on a show while doing so. A tree percolator is a specific type of percolator that consists of a central tube that runs up through the body of the hydro-filtration device, with multiple arms extending down from the top like the branches of a tree. These arms are equipped with small slits or holes at the bottom that allow the aroma to diffuse and cool down as it passes through the water in the chamber. This results in smoother, more enjoyable aroma. With a tree percolator, you can expect less harsh draws and better filtration of impurities. The Big Tree Percolator belongs in a class all on its own, featuring a 12-arm perc that will elevate your custom hydro-filtration device in a big way.; Product Specs:. Category: Accessories. Brand: Prism Pipes.

The Halo Connectors on our Custom Hydro-filtration Devices, and all pre-built hydro-vessels from Prism Handheld Pieces, are equipped with patented Halo Connectors that allow you to seamlessly swap parts and add new accessories, including any number of these glass percolators. You’ll need at least two Halo Connectors to add a glass percolator to any modular custom hydro-filtration device or Prism Handheld Pieces hydro-vessel (one to connect to the Key features: base and one to screw in the mouthpiece ). There are two types of modular hydro-filtration device percolators from Prism Handheld Pieces, showerhead and tree. Each replacement perc is available in two sizes, standard or big, and the specifications of each are listed below.; The Showerhead Percolator is an ideal choice for adding filtration and additional features to your Custom Hydro-filtration Device. A showerhead percolator is a type of percolator found in hydro-filtration devices that resembles a showerhead. It consists of a tube with holes or slits at the bottom that flares outwards, allowing aroma to be filtered and cooled before inhalation. Showerhead percolators are one of the most popular types of percs found in hydro-filtration devices due to their simple design and ability to provide effective filtration. Constructed with thin slits to ensure maximum airflow, the Prism Handheld Pieces Showerhead Percolator distributes your aroma evenly throughout its chamber while you pull for ultra-smooth draws. The Big Showerhead Percolator operates the same way while adding a bit more size and volume to your hydro-filtration device.; Incorporating a Prism Handheld Pieces Tree Percolator into your modular hydro-vessel will add a ton of filtration to each draw and put on a show while doing so. A tree percolator is a specific type of percolator that consists of a central tube that runs up through the body of the hydro-filtration device, with multiple arms extending down from the top like the branches of a tree. These arms are equipped with small slits or holes at the bottom that allow the aroma to diffuse and cool down as it passes through the water in the chamber. This results in smoother, more enjoyable aroma. With a tree percolator, you can expect less harsh draws and better filtration of impurities. The Big Tree Percolator belongs in a class all on its own, featuring a 12-arm perc that will elevate your custom hydro-filtration device in a big way.; Product Specs:. Category: Accessories. Brand: Prism Pipes.

item.g:title: Prism Handheld Pieces Replacement Halo Connectors - Green
item.g:description: Prism Handheld Pieces reinvented the modular hydro-filtration device with the patented Halo Connectors you see here. Halo Connectors are the glue that keeps your custom hydro-filtration device flawlessly intact. Instead of relying on the often unreliable plastic clips and metal clamps associated with modular hydro-filtration devices of the past, Prism’s Halo Connectors allow you to safely and securely screw each section of your modular hydro-filtration device into one another. Whether you're looking to replace a broken connector, swap out colors, or add a new section to your custom hydro-filtration device, Halo Connectors always make the job quick and easy. Snag a Halo Connector with a new Percolator and you can quickly add an entirely new section into the middle of your existing modular hydro-filtration device! Each Halo Connector features an anodized aluminum outer sleeve in your choice of color. The sleeve contains a patented molded plastic insert that offers an airtight seal when your hydro-vessel is fully assembled. Silicone gaskets located inside each connector allow each replaceable part of your modular hydro-filtration device to safely twist in place while keeping your decals perfectly aligned. These replacement Halo Connectors work with any custom hydro-filtration device designed in our build-a-hydro-filtration device app and all pre-built hydro-vessels from Key features: Prism Handheld Pieces; as well.; Prism Handheld Pieces Halo Connectors; Anodized Aluminum Sleeve. Category: Accessories. Brand: Prism Pipes.

item.g:title: Pulsar 8.25” Valentine’s Rose Essential Extract Filtration System Kit

All over, decals of flowers and sweethearts adorn the body while a pink heart mouthpiece makes sure love is always in the air. item.g:title: Chill Steel Handheld Pieces - Chill Hydro-filtration Devices - Tommy Chong Paisley Blue
item.g:description: Introducing the world’s first stainless steel, vacuum-insulated hydro-filtration device from Chill Steel Handheld Pieces! Designed with the same double-wall vacuum insulation used in RTIC and Yeti Tumblers that keep your drinks cold for hours on end, the Chill Hydro-filtration Device keeps the water inside your piece ice-cold for up to 12 hours. The Chill Hydro-filtration Device from Chill Steel Handheld Pieces is made from extremely durable stainless steel and is designed to withstand whatever life throws its way. The practically indestructible stainless steel body is complemented by an aluminum diffuser downstem that filters your aroma through the icy-cold water inside. The downstem provides a 14mm female pre-rolled inhalation unit that securely holds an included 14mm glass material receptacle piece. The Chill Hydro-filtration Device interior is lined with a ceramic coating that stays clean longer and easily cleans with just isopropyl alcohol. Chill Steel Handheld Pieces measure 13” inches tall when fully assembled and feature removable parts for easy customization. Key features: Enjoying the coldest rips in the game is a breeze with the Chill Stainless Steel Hydro-vessel. Whether using it at home or on the go, the double-wall vacuum-insulated construction on the Chill Hydro-filtration Device prevents heat from penetrating the inside to keep your ice solid, your water cold, and your hydro-filtration device draws exceptionally smooth. Just twist off the neck of the handheld piece to fill it with ice, add water to the fill line, and prepare for the coldest rips you’ve ever experienced!; Chill Steel Handheld Pieces Insulated Hydro-vessel; Double-Wall Vacuum Insulation; Durable Stainless Steel Body. Category: Water Filtration Devices. Brand: Chill Steel Pipes.

item.g:title: Pulsar 14” Double Wall Transporter Straight Tube Hydro-filtration Device - Bicolor Green Gray Glass
item.g:description: Put on a show with the Pulsar Double Wall Transporter Straight Tube Hydro-filtration Device! Made from thick borosilicate glass, this hydro-vessel has a wide base for stability. item.g:title: Yocan Black Pocket Essential Extract Thermal Extractor - Jet Black
item.g:description: The Yocan Pocket Essential Extract Thermal Extractor is a pocket-sized powerhouse that draws harder than Monday morning reality. This premium aromatherapy device pen is packed to the brim with advanced features for extracts, including precision temperature control that can be fine-tuned down to a single degree, a fully ceramic 360-degree heating chamber, built-in glass pearls that stir your essential extracts as you inhale for maximum efficiency, and a powerful long lasting battery. The digital interface offers full control of your settings and delivers flavorful clouds wherever life takes you. If you’ve been searching for a portable essential oil aromatherapy device that doesn’t compromise on performance, this is the one. Adding both value and function, the Yocan Black Pocket Essential Extract Thermal Extractor comes with a glass pearl stirrer that keeps your essential oil evenly mixed inside the chamber for smooth, flavorful draws without leftover buildup. The angled mouthpiece makes every pull more comfortable while doubling as a heat and splash guard to protect your lips during high-temp sessions. The mouthpiece has a tethered cap makes reloading essential extracts into the chamber quick and easy while simplifying cleaning and maintenance. Key features: Speaking of the chamber, the Yocan Pocket Extract Pen features it's Cloud 3 Atomizer, a fully ceramic heating element engineered for slow, steady, and even vaporization. Unlike metal coils that can scorch your essential oil, ceramic heats essential oil essential extracts gently to unlock pure flavor without harshness. The 360° heating surface ensures there are no hot or cold spots, meaning every bit of material is vaporized efficiently. The result is smoother vapor, richer terp profiles, and a cleaner overall experience that’s easier on the lungs and truer to your essential extracts. With a larger chamber for bigger loads, optimized airflow for smoother pulls, and a lifespan rated for 2,000+ sessions, the Cloud 3 Coil is built for success.; The Yocan Pocket Thermal Extractor features precision temperature control ranging from 400°F to 580°F (204°C–304°C) with one-degree accuracy so you can always dial in your sesh exactly how you like it. Lower temps give you smooth, terp-rich draws, while higher settings unlock heavy clouds that’ll keep you glued to the couch. This extract pen is powered by a long-lasting battery that delivers up to 15 sessions per charge and recharges in under 90 minutes with USB-C fast charging. Compact, powerful, and engineered for both flavor chasers and cloud hunters, the Yocan Black Pocket Thermal Extractor punches way above its weight class.; Yocan Black Pocket Essential Extract Thermal Extractor Precision Temp Control (400°F–580°F); Fully Ceramic Cloud 3 Heating Chamber 360° Even Heat Distribution Glass Pearl Stirrer System. item.g:title: Yocan Black Pocket Essential Extract Thermal Extractor - Sky Blue
item.g:description: The Yocan Pocket Essential Extract Thermal Extractor is a pocket-sized powerhouse that draws harder than Monday morning reality. This premium aromatherapy device pen is packed to the brim with advanced features for extracts, including precision temperature control that can be fine-tuned down to a single degree, a fully ceramic 360-degree heating chamber, built-in glass pearls that stir your essential extracts as you inhale for maximum efficiency, and a powerful long lasting battery. The digital interface offers full control of your settings and delivers flavorful clouds wherever life takes you. If you’ve been searching for a portable essential oil aromatherapy device that doesn’t compromise on performance, this is the one. Adding both value and function, the Yocan Black Pocket Essential Extract Thermal Extractor comes with a glass pearl stirrer that keeps your essential oil evenly mixed inside the chamber for smooth, flavorful draws without leftover buildup. The angled mouthpiece makes every pull more comfortable while doubling as a heat and splash guard to protect your lips during high-temp sessions. The mouthpiece has a tethered cap makes reloading essential extracts into the chamber quick and easy while simplifying cleaning and maintenance. Key features: Speaking of the chamber, the Yocan Pocket Extract Pen features it's Cloud 3 Atomizer, a fully ceramic heating element engineered for slow, steady, and even vaporization. Unlike metal coils that can scorch your essential oil, ceramic heats essential oil essential extracts gently to unlock pure flavor without harshness. The 360° heating surface ensures there are no hot or cold spots, meaning every bit of material is vaporized efficiently. The result is smoother vapor, richer terp profiles, and a cleaner overall experience that’s easier on the lungs and truer to your essential extracts. With a larger chamber for bigger loads, optimized airflow for smoother pulls, and a lifespan rated for 2,000+ sessions, the Cloud 3 Coil is built for success.; The Yocan Pocket Thermal Extractor features precision temperature control ranging from 400°F to 580°F (204°C–304°C) with one-degree accuracy so you can always dial in your sesh exactly how you like it. Lower temps give you smooth, terp-rich draws, while higher settings unlock heavy clouds that’ll keep you glued to the couch. This extract pen is powered by a long-lasting battery that delivers up to 15 sessions per charge and recharges in under 90 minutes with USB-C fast charging. Compact, powerful, and engineered for both flavor chasers and cloud hunters, the Yocan Black Pocket Thermal Extractor punches way above its weight class.; Yocan Black Pocket Essential Extract Thermal Extractor Precision Temp Control (400°F–580°F); Fully Ceramic Cloud 3 Heating Chamber 360° Even Heat Distribution Glass Pearl Stirrer System. Category: Thermal Extraction Devices. Brand: Yocan.

item.g:description: Beam up your terps with the HEMPER UFO Vortex Hydro-filtration Device! This UFO-themed desktop filtration apparatus is designed for the ultimate flavor ride into space. This dual-chamber desktop filtration apparatus includes both human AND hidden alien technology to cool your vapors while preserving your terpenes. In the bottom chamber, we've added the classic 6-slit inline perc for maximum diffusion, but after that, it gets a little bit alien... In the upper chamber, we've included several venturi inlets to pull in and spin air into a vortex of smooth and flavorful vapor. This UFO hydro-filtration device is the larger edition of our UFO Vortex desktop filtration apparatus, made larger with an extra chamber for huge botanical rips! We've added our inline percolator to push aroma bubbles up into a vortex chamber that spins and cools the aroma for a smoother draw. The added venturi inlets cause aroma to spin creating a cyclone effect that you can watch! Beam up some huge hydro-filtration device rips with the HEMPER Mothership UFO Hydro-filtration Device! item.g:title: Dr. Dabber Switch 2 E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus Thermal Extractor
item.g:description: Introducing the Switch 2nd Edition, the pinnacle of over a decade of innovation and customer feedback. The Switch 2 brings a host of groundbreaking features that set it apart from every other eRig on the market such as its IR Sensor Technology, offering precision heating like never before. This exclusive feature ensures unparalleled temperature control, allowing for a more accurate and consistent extract. Thanks to omni-directional induction heating, the Switch 2 heats evenly from both the sidewalls and the base of the insert. This results in a more efficient, even heat distribution, enhancing both flavor and vapor production. Say goodbye to the frustration of failed atomizers. The Switch 2 includes a 20mm Quartz Insert, offering a 300% increase in capacity compared to the original Switch. This means it can easily handle extracts of all sizes without compromising on performance or flavor. Key features: The Switch 2 introduces three dynamic heating modes that redefine your electric extract experience. Descent Mode mimics traditional high-output ignition source extracting by reducing temperature gradually at a rate of 1° per second. This mode preserves terpenes and eliminates the burnt taste, giving you smooth, flavorful draws every time. Ascent Mode is perfect for low-temp enthusiasts and terp chasers, gradually increasing the temperature for an ideal, flavorful experience from start to finish. Steady Mode maintains a consistent temperature throughout your session, adjusting based on the size of your extract and the rate of inhalation for an optimal experience.; Take full control with the Dr. Dabber App. Personalize your extracting experience by adjusting temperature profiles, hold times, session durations, and light modes for complete customization at your fingertips. Whether you're a seasoned dabber or new to the world of eRigs, the Switch 2 provides a level of performance, control, and customization that will elevate your experience to new heights.; Compatible Dry Herbs & Essential Oil 🌿🍯; Dr. Dabber Switch 2 E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus Thermal Extractor. Category: Thermal Extraction Devices. Brand: Dr. Dabber.

item.g:title: Dr. Dabber Switch 2 Replacement Glass Attachment
item.g:description: This is a Replacement Glass Percolator Attachment designed for use with the Dr. Dabber Switch 2. This heavy-duty borosilicate glass attachment functions exactly the same as the original glass included with the Switch 2, strategically designed to deliver super smooth draws from your favorite essential oil essential extracts and dry botanical strains. The glass is custom-blown for the Switch 2 and fits snugly into the top of the thermal extractor. It utilizes a laser-cut percolator for refined water filtration and a large chamber with ample room for water and vapor production. The Dr Dabber Switch 2 Replacement Glass Attachment is an OEM (original equipment manufacturer) replacement part made specifically for use with the Dr. Dabber Switch 2. Key features: Dr. Dabber Switch 2 Replacement Glass; Heavy-Duty Borosilicate Glass; Large Water Chamber; Cools & Filters Vapor. Category: Accessories. Brand: Dr. Dabber.

item.g:title: Storz & Bickel Crafty+ Thermal Extractor
item.g:description: Storz & Bickel designed the Crafty+ Thermal Extractor to be the best in class handheld Thermal Extractor on the market. Taking the original Crafty back to the drawing board, this redesigned portable thermal extractor delivers more sessions and faster heat-up times than its predecessor thanks to a beefed-up battery and updated circuit board. Three preset temperature settings make this handheld aromatherapy device super easy to use, each one optimized for immediate heating of your dry herbs. A brand new Super-Boost Mode even provides thick vapor clouds with just 3 clicks! Despite being packed with more powerful technology and innovative new features, the Crafty+ Thermal Extractor sports a slimmer, more pocket-friendly body that is always easy to conceal. Storz & Bickel engineered the Crafty+ Thermal Extractor with a hybrid heating system that combines conduction and convection heating methods. This patented technology is proven to excel in evenly heating your materials inside the chamber and enables the Crafty+ to quickly reach your desired temperatures with little to no risk of combustion. The powerful heating system also provides exceptional airflow and minimal draw resistance that allows you to breathe in effortlessly from the swivel mouthpiece. The Storz & Bickel Crafty+ is equipped with a state-of-the-art cooling unit that cools your vapor to a pleasant temperature before inhalation. This ingenious cooling unit is made from PEEK, a high-grade heat-resistant plastic that works to extend the vapor path and give each draw maximum time to cool down. As your vapor leaves the heating chamber, a screen prevents your materials from pulling through as each draw enters the cooling unit. Ultra-low draw resistance coupled with a revolutionary combination heating system allows for smooth, plentiful vapor clouds with every use. Key features: Measuring just over 4” inches tall, the Crafty+ Thermal Extractor is now the smallest and stealthiest aromatherapy device available in the Storz & Bickel lineup. The same tactical design used on the original Crafty has been implemented on the new Crafty+, featuring a ribbed exterior that resembles a radiator. This unique design not only provides an exceptional grip but allows heat to dissipate from the grooves so the device never overheats in your hands during back-to-back draws. The new Crafty+ also has the same swivel-style mouthpiece as the original that flips out while in use and flips back in when you're ready to move. This streamlined design is perfect for on-the-go aromatherapy. Compact, lightweight, and built to withstand everyday wear & tear, this discreet thermal extractor can be easily carried in your pockets and is the ultimate travel companion for all of life’s adventures.; The improved battery of the Crafty+ Thermal Extractor was designed to provide more back-to-back sessions with less time spent charging your device. Compared to its predecessor, the Crafty+ boasts a 30% faster heat-up time that is ready for action in as little as 60 seconds. The brand new Super Boost mode can be activated with a triple-click of the power button and provides extra thick vapor clouds from your chosen materials by sending the temperature straight to the maximum of 410°F. While the Crafty+ features three temperature settings that are optimized for immediate use, the Remote Control App for Android** allows you to pinpoint various heat settings according to personal preferences from your smartphone! The Remote Control App gives you total, customized control over all the Crafty+ settings and connects to your thermal extractor wirelessly via Bluetooth.; Using the Crafty+ Thermal Extractor is simple and easy. Single-button controls allow you to toggle between the three preset temperature settings and turn the device on/off, while built-in LED lights correspond to each selection. The top of the thermal extractor can be twisted off for inserting your materials. The Crafty+ loading chamber is always ready for use with dry herbs. Once your materials are loaded, place the top back onto the body of the thermal extractor, choose your desired temperature, and the Crafty+ will vibrate to let you know it's ready! The Crafty+ provides the same reliable performance and outstanding vapor quality you’d expect from a Storz & Bickel Thermal Extractor with a sleek intuitive design, new innovative features, and more powerful technology that always delivers. Don’t sacrifice performance for portability when you can get both with the Crafty+ Thermal Extractor from Storz & Bickel today!; Storz & Bickel Crafty Plus Thermal Extractor. Category: Thermal Extraction Devices. Brand: Storz & Bickel.

item.g:title: New Puffco Peak Pro 3DXL eRig (Version 2) - Onyx Black
item.g:description: The New Peak Pro 3DXL is an updated version of the New Puffco Peak Pro and comes equipped with Puffco's powerful 3DXL chamber. The 3DXL chamber is 78% larger than the 3D Chamber and produces twice as much vapor. This premium electric essential extract filtration system shines brighter than any other eRig on the market with customizable animated light shows that glow brightly on your choice of a pearl white, onyx black, or the newest storm blue silicone base. The New Peak Pro 3DXL is highlighted by an improved glass hydrated micro-filtration device that features an inner perc with laser-cut slits to filter and cool your extracts to perfection. It also has a new joystick carb cap that offers better control of the airflow. The New Puffco Peak Pro 3DXL has all of the features you love from the Puffco Peak and Peak Pro combined with cutting-edge advancements guaranteed to elevate your overall aromatherapy experience. The New Puffco Peak Pro 3DXL offers one of the highest levels of customization and control available in an electric essential extract filtration system today. If you’re new to extracts, the New Peak Pro 3DXL presents an exceptionally efficient and smooth pathway to delve into the world of essential extracts. Meanwhile, for those well-versed in the art of extracting, it provides an unparalleled realm of personalization and mastery, enabling precise adjustments to curate the perfect extracting journey you seek. The included 3DXL Chamber is larger than the 3D Chamber and offers a superior extracting experience. It is the engine that drives the New Peak Pro 3DXL experience and features heat tracers embedded inside the ceramic walls of the chamber to ensure consistent heating and optimal flavor. item.g:title: Pulsar 6” Scientific Recycler Essential Extract Filtration System
item.g:description: Experience the epitome of smooth extracting with the Pulsar Scientific Recycler Essential Extract Filtration System, a mini desktop filtration apparatus designed for those who appreciate both aesthetics and functionality. This desktop filtration apparatus is skillfully crafted from high-quality borosilicate glass, renowned for its durability and heat resistance. Standing 6” inches tall, it's the perfect size for both convenience and performance. Each desktop filtration apparatus comes equipped with a 14mm male quartz thermal displacement adapter style quartz crucible, specifically designed to accommodate larger extracts while preventing excess essential extract from being drawn into the handheld piece. The Pulsar Scientific Recycler Essential Extract Filtration System stands out with its unique and modern design. It features a tapered base chamber and a visually striking "floating" upper chamber. These two chambers are ingeniously connected by exterior handheld pieces and a perforated downstem, creating an effective recycler system. As you inhale, vapors and water are rapidly cycled through this system, delivering cooling power and ensuring each draw is cool, smooth, and flavor-rich. The desktop filtration apparatus is completed with a decorative angled mouthpiece, enhancing its ergonomic comfort and contemporary aesthetic. Key features: The recycler functionality of this essential extract filtration system is not just for show; it plays a crucial role in providing a superior extracting experience. The rapid cycling of water and vapors not only cools the aroma but also filters it, resulting in a cleaner and more enjoyable draw. item.g:title: Pulsar Rounded Material Receptacle Slide - 14mm Male Pre-rolled Inhalation Unit
item.g:description: These glass hydro-vessel material receptacles from Pulsar are a reliable replacement accessory for any broken or misplaced material receptacle pieces on your hydro-vessels and glass hydro-filtration devices. The Pulsar Rounded Material Receptacle Slide is made from thick borosilicate glass that is highly heat-resistant, working to preserve the tastes of your dry herbs while remaining cool to the touch. The disc-shaped glass handle offers an excellent grip while in use and doubles as a convenient roll stop to prevent your material receptacle from rolling away when tabled. This replacement material receptacle piece is equipped with a 14mm male pre-rolled inhalation unit and will fit any hydro-vessel with a 14mm female pre-rolled inhalation unit. Pulsar Rounded Material Receptacle Slide Key features: Thick Borosilicate Glass; Worked Glass Handle; 14mm Male Pre-rolled Inhalation Unit; Polished Pre-rolled Inhalation Unit. Category: Accessories. Brand: Pulsar.

item.g:title: Pulsar 10-Piece Quartz Crucible/Material Receptacle Display (14mm) - Blue
item.g:description: Proudly keep your full collection on display with this unique glass accessory from Pulsar! The 10-Piece Quartz Crucible/Material Receptacle Display features a 20” inch long menorah-shaped body that is equipped to hold a total of ten 14mm male accessories (not included). If you have a large assortment of 14mm material receptacles and quartz crucibles, this display will keep them secure and out of harm’s way. It also ensures your favorite small pieces stay organized and are always within arm’s reach. Pulsar’s 10-piece Quartz Crucible/Material Receptacle Display is constructed with thick borosilicate glass to keep it weighed down, while two color accented flared bases on opposite ends keep it sturdy on any flat surface. Give your 14mm accessories a new place to call home with the Pulsar 10-Piece Quartz Crucible/Material Receptacle Display today! Pulsar 10-Piece Quartz Crucible/Material Receptacle Display Key features: Female Pre-rolled Inhalation Units Fit Male Accessories; Premium Borosilicate Glass; Menorah-Shaped Body; Unique Display Piece. Category: Accessories. Brand: Pulsar.

item.g:title: Yocan UNI Magnetic Sealed Extract Cartridge Adapters
item.g:description: This is a replacement magnetic adapter designed for use with all models of the Yocan UNI Thermal Extractor, including the Yocan UNI, UNI Pro, and UNI Pro 2.0. These replacement magnetic rings connect to the bottom of standard 510-threaded oil tanks and pre-filled sealed extract cartridge to enable easy magnetic attachment to the UNI Aromatherapy Device Battery. Rather than screw in your oil tank, the Yocan UNI Magnetic Caps allow you to “snap” your sealed extract cartridge into the port, where it’s safely concealed within the handheld aromatherapy device battery. Yocan UNI Magnetic Adapter Caps are constructed with high-grade metal and a powerful neodymium magnet for a secure connection. Yocan UNI Replacement Magnetic Adapters Key features: Fits the Yocan UNI, UNI Pro & UNI Pro 2.0; Fits Standard 510-Thread sealed extract cartridge; Designed for All Yocan UNI Models; Powerful Neodymium Magnet. Category: Accessories. Brand: Yocan.

item.g:title: Blazer Big Buddy Turbo High-Output Ignition Source - Black/Stainless
item.g:description: Designed for fast and efficient extracting, the Blazer Big Buddy TURBO high-output ignition source offers an extremely powerful 2500F flame and an impressive 60 minute continuous burn time--all in one easy-to-use, portable butane extract high-output ignition source. Offering more than the average extract high-output ignition source, the Big Buddy ensures safe and satisfying extract sessions with a precise flame height adjuster, flame lock lever, and igniter button with safety lock. A detachable stand keeps the high-output ignition source upright when at rest in between extracts. Boasting a larger nozzle and butane capacity than other extracting high-output ignition source, the Big Buddy offers more power and convenience with the same portable design for which Blazer is known. Enjoy mastery over your extract sessions with this compact yet powerful extract high-output ignition source. Blazer Big Buddy Turbo high-output ignition source 🔥 Key features: 60-Minute Continuous Burn Time; Precision Flame Height Adjuster; Continuous Flame Lock Lever; Maximum 2500F Flame. Category: Accessories. Brand: Blazer.

item.g:title: Storz & Bickel Volcano Thermal Extractor Balloon Bags
item.g:description: Keep on aromatherapy with this affordable 10 foot roll of Volcano Thermal Extractor Balloon Bags! Storz & Bickel highly recommends replacing your Volcano Thermal Extractor bags after 50-100 uses to maintain an optimal flavorful, and efficient aromatherapy experience throughout your desktop aromatherapy device’s lifetime. This Volcano replacement accessory includes one extra large bag that measures 10 feet long by 1 foot wide. The balloon bag can be used in its entirety as an extra large super duper party bag, or cut into multiple smaller bags, making it super convenient to customize the size of your replacement bags. These Volcano Thermal Extractor Balloon Bags are designed for both the Volcano Classic and Volcano Digital Thermal Extractors in addition to the Solid Valve Set (as opposed to the easy valve set where bags come pre-attached to the mouthpiece). If you’re looking for new replacement balloon bags for your Volcano Thermal Extractor pre-installed with the easy valve, you’ll want the Easy Valve Replacement Set instead. Just like the bags included with every Storz & Bickel unit, these replacement balloon bags will keep your vapor airtight and fresh for up to 8 hours! Key features: Aromatherapy Device Compatibility:; Fits the Volcano Classic Thermal Extractor; Fits the Volcano Digital Thermal Extractor; Fits the Volcano Hybrid Thermal Extractor. Category: Accessories. Brand: Storz & Bickel.

item.g:title: Volcano Thermal Extractor Easy Valve Starter Set
item.g:description: The Storz & Bickel Easy Valve Starter Set is compatible with the Volcano Classic and the Volcano Digital Thermal Extractors. The Starter Set allows multiple users to enjoy their own vapor-filled balloon bag and individual mouthpiece. The Easy Valve Starter Set includes four hassle-free balloons that come ready for action with the mouthpieces already attached. This Thermal Extractor kit also includes a variety of smaller Volcano accessories to take your favorite desktop unit to a whole new level of production and functionality. Key features: Aromatherapy Device Compatibility:; Fits the Volcano Classic Thermal Extractor; Fits the Volcano Digital Thermal Extractor; Storz & Bickel Easy Valve Starter Set. Category: Accessories. Brand: Storz & Bickel.

item.g:title: Volcano Thermal Extractor Easy Valve Replacement Set (Balloon Bags)
item.g:description: The Storz & Bickel Easy Valve Replacement Set contains a six-pack of 2 foot balloon bags and six pre-attached Easy Valve Mouthpieces. These disposable balloons and mouthpieces are cost-effective replacements designed for use with the Volcano Classic, Volcano Digital, and Volcano Hybrid Thermal Extractors, offering easier handling with no assembly needed. Aromatherapy Device Compatibility: Key features: Fits the Volcano Classic Thermal Extractor; Fits the Volcano Digital Thermal Extractor; Fits the Volcano Hybrid Thermal Extractor; Storz & Bickel Easy Valve Replacement Set. Category: Accessories. Brand: Storz & Bickel.

item.g:title: Aroma Buddy Junior Sploof Air Filter - Black
item.g:description: Looking for a way to hide that smell? Meet the Aroma Buddy Junior! By utilizing an advanced air filter, this portable device is perfect for eliminating any type of unwanted smell or odor. The Aroma Buddy Junior is an environmentally friendly product that keeps secondhand aroma away from friends, family, and neighbors. Its compact and lightweight design makes it small enough to fit inside your pocket, and it's perfect for travel or storing discreetly. This new "Junior" version of the Aroma Buddy makes it easier than ever to transport and use discreetly. Aroma Buddy Junior Sploof Air Filter Key features: Controls Second-Hand Aroma; Environmentally Safe Design; Pocket-Friendly Junior Size; Estimated at 600+ Uses. Category: Accessories. item.g:title: Pulsar 510 DL 2.0 Pro Auto-Draw Aromatherapy Device Bar - Black Cherry Fizz
item.g:description: The upgraded Pulsar 510 DL 2.0 Pro is the perfect companion for discreet puffs wherever you go. The device comes in a range of finishes. The original color line features a lightweight metal shell, while the Thermochromic Series and Mist Series offer durable plastic constructions with special coatings for an eye-catching look. The new silicone mouthpiece offers heat resistance and comfort for on-the-go use. The auto-draw function is cleverly designed to mimic a bar-style disposable aromatherapy device, allowing for inconspicuous use in public. Easily activate the device and switch through voltage settings with a series of quick draws, or use the tactile button at the base for manual control. The Pulsar 510 DL 2.0 Pro is packed with new features, including an expanded 1000mAh battery for longer enjoyment between charges. It comes with five voltage settings, including two lower temperature options for cooler, flavor-rich draws that are gentler on your sealed extract cartridge and help preserve terpenes. The innovative 15-second pre-heat function primes sealed extract cartridge efficiently, preventing clogs for a smooth aromatherapy experience. Key features: Monitor battery life and voltage settings on the side digital display, and track your usage with the added puff counter. The LED light ring at the base changes color according to the voltage setting for easy visual confirmation. Once charged, simply attach your 510 threaded sealed extract cartridge with the magnetic base, and the unit is ready for use. Haptic feedback ensures everything is correctly set up, whether you're selecting a pre-heating cycle or changing voltage. item.g:title: Pulsar APX eRig Thermal Extractor
item.g:description: The Pulsar APX eRig features its most powerful battery to date and is designed to deliver thick rips of vapor to elevate your extracting sessions to new heights. This remarkable device combines the immense power necessary for peak extract performance with the refreshing sensation of water filtration, ensuring each session is nothing short of spectacular. Crafted to mirror the classic straight tube hydro-filtration device aesthetic, the APX eRig incorporates ultra-durable borosilicate glass in its design, standing tall at just over 10.5” inches. Its broad base ensures stability, while the ergonomic mouthpiece guarantees an optimal seal for each draw. The chamber of the desktop filtration apparatus houses a smoky glass downstem and a circular showerhead percolator, offering a full 360-degree diffusion for silky smooth, water-cooled vapors. Innovatively designed, the desktop filtration apparatus's atomizer arm swivels, allowing for a relaxed usage angle while keeping the atomizer upright for heating. The device features a coil-less quartz cup atomizer that connects seamlessly, topped with a borosilicate glass collar and carb cap linked by a silicone band. Included in the setup are two quartz terp pearls that enhance the vaporization process by stirring the essential extract as it heats, ensuring a thorough and even vapor production. The desktop filtration apparatus also comes with the "terp tong," a novel tool designed for easy handling of the terp pearls, allowing for effortless placement and removal without needing to detach the atomizer arm. Key features: Boasting a significant 3200mAh battery, this eRig promises powerful and dense vapor clouds. Activation is simple, with a five-click control button that also features an LED light ring for visual appeal. Additional LEDs cast an enchanting glow beneath the desktop filtration apparatus, creating ambiance for each session. The device offers five temperature settings, each indicated by color-coded LEDs, ranging from cooler, flavor-focused blues and greens to the intense warmth of purples and reds for those seeking a more robust session. Engage the Sesh Mode with a double button press to initiate a pre-heating cycle, complete with pulsating lights and haptic feedback to signal when it's ready for use. For any remaining essential extracts, the Manual Mode ensures nothing goes to waste, maximizing each session's potential.; Maintenance is streamlined to ensure the longevity of the eRig. Simple cleaning involves wiping the atomizer with an isopropyl alcohol-dipped cotton swab post-cooling. The device can be disassembled for a deeper clean. Convenient USB-C charging keeps the device ready for your next session, and a battery level indicator lets you know when you need a charge. With the Pulsar APX eRig, each extracting experience is elevated, combining powerful performance with ease of use and maintenance for unparalleled extract sessions.; The Pulsar APX eRig Thermal Extractor is a highly vetted addition to the Thermal Extractors lineup. this piece was evaluated for material quality, performance consistency, and long-term durability.; We bypass retail markups to bring you hardware that merges high-end lifestyle aesthetics with pure functional engineering. just the exact specifications you need to make an informed upgrade to your setup.. item.g:title: Puffco Peak Pro 3D Chamber
item.g:description: At the heart of the Peak Pro experience lies the revolutionary Peak Pro 3D Chamber, a pivotal driving force in Puffco’s electric essential extract filtration system technology. The 3D Chamber is a replaceable atomizer for the Peak Pro and New Peak Pro that combines the ceramic chamber, where you load your materials, and the heating element powered by the base. The 3D Chamber features heat traces embedded inside the ceramic walls that vaporize essential extracts from the sides rather than the bottom, unlike traditional eRigs. This avant-garde approach safeguards the integrity of terpenes and cannabinoids, preserving their potency for optimal effects and unparalleled flavor. Each Peak Pro atomizer is complete with cutting-edge sensors that deliver instantaneous temperature regulation. Embrace larger clouds, enhanced flavors, and unwaveringly reliable draws with Puffco’s patented 3D Chamber. Designed for Essential Oil Essential Extracts 🍯 Key features: Puffco Peak Pro 3D Chamber; Fits the New Peak Pro eRig; Fits the Puffco Peak Pro; Simple to Replace. Category: Accessories. Brand: Puffco.

item.g:description: The Boost EVO Quartz Atomizer is a fully built component that includes Dr. Dabber's proprietary IntelliTEMP heating element, a quartz vaporizing chamber, and a stainless steel body. This replacement atomizer's heating element and internals stay completely isolated from your oils and the vapor-path to prevent residue build-up. The IntelliTEMP heating element includes a built-in sensor that sends feedback on the atomizer's temperature in real-time to the unit and ensures a reliable aromatherapy experience. The Boost EVO Quartz Atomizer also features a Snaptech magnetic system, making the loading process incredibly simple with no threading or twisting necessary for insertion or removal. The Dr. Dabber Boost EVO Quartz Atomizer is an OEM (original equipment manufacturer) accessory designed specifically for use with the Dr. Dabber Boost EVO Thermal Extractor. item.g:description: The Honeybee botanical Yellow Line Carb Caps are designed to produce the perfect airflow to maximize the vaporization of your essential extracts. item.g:title: Raw Classic King Size Slim Single-Use Delivery Paper - 50ct Display - Full Box (50 packs)
item.g:description: Raw Classic King Size Slim single-use delivery paper are a staple in the rolling community and it’s no question why they’re so highly regarded. Raw’s single-use delivery paper are unlike most other papers on the market because they are entirely pure and unprocessed. Made from natural hemp fibers with a hemp-based gum, these all-natural king size single-use delivery paper contain a hybrid blend of unbleached (not chlorine-whitened) fibers, so the paper stays a naturally translucent light-brown color and maintains a thinness you can practically see through. Each paper contains Raw’s patented run-preventing watermark that ensures every paper burns slowly and evenly. This unique criss-cross watermark system helps to prevent runs and maintain the smooth even-burning characteristics that make Raw single-use delivery paper so famous. Raw Classic King Size Slim single-use delivery paper are an all-time classic and the perfect accessory for any aromatherapy user that enjoys rolling sizeable pre-rolled inhalation units for group sessions. Each King Size Slim Rolling Paper measures 110mm in length, or approximately 4.33” inches long by 1.65” inches tall/wide. Raw’s “King Slim” measurements are slightly less wide compared to traditional king size papers to eliminate aromatherapy session excess amounts of paper. Completely unbleached, chlorine-free, organic, and vegan-friendly, these papers are a no-brainer. Each booklet contains 32 all-natural single-use delivery paper and each box contains 50 packs when you're ready to truly step up your rolling game. Snag some Raw Classic King Size Slim single-use delivery paper today and see for yourself what makes this brand so special! Key features: Raw® King Size Slim single-use delivery paper; Run-Preventing Watermark; 110mm Length (4” inches); Unbleached & Unrefined. Category: Single-Use Delivery Papers. item.g:title: The HyperDyn (Intl)
item.g:description: The HyperDyn is DynaVap’s first “Big Material Receptacle” thermal extractor, offering a completely new experience with its state-of-the-art tip and cap combination. Featuring a larger chamber volume (average of 0.25g), the HyperDyn is constructed with medical grade titanium, colored and protected by DynaVap’s coating technology. The HyperDyn boasts a 10mm and 14mm taper, accommodating water piece use, and remains modular with previous DynaVap midsections, tips, and mouthpieces. WHO IS THE HYPERDYN FOR? Key features: Connoisseurs looking for a “session style” DynaVap aromatherapy experience.; BENEFITS; Massive Rips & Heavy Draws: Pushing thermal extractions to the limit.; Durability: High quality and built to last a lifetime, the titanium HyperDyn is fully machined and crafted in Wisconsin, USA.. Category: Vaporizer. Brand: DynaVap.

item.g:title: The UniDyn (Intl)
item.g:description: Introducing the UniDyn, DynaVap’s newest thermal extractor created for flavor, efficiency, and simplicity. Machined in our shop and crafted from lightweight titanium, the UniDyn Ball Aromatherapy Device features an industry first ultralight UniBody, integrating the tip and stem seamlessly into one unit. This cutting-edge design incorporates our new T-Break heat break technology between the extraction chamber and stem. The UniDyn thermal extraction device is visually enhanced and protected by DynaVap’s DuraDyn finish. Combining the convection of our new BallR Cap, this XL length device delivers a deliciously smooth and flavorful experience. Whether you're microdosing or packing a full material receptacle, the UniDyn’s adjustable extraction chamber and condenser with 7 airflow settings allow for a truly personalized session. Key features: WHO IS THE UNIDYN FOR?; The UniDyn thermal extractor is crafted for flavor chasers who demand an unadulterated, pure vapor experience. Its medical-grade titanium construction delivers a clean flavor profile and, paired with the convection of the BallR Cap, creates a session that truly highlights your material's natural essence—all with minimal maintenance.; Whether you're a seasoned DynaVap enthusiast or just exploring premium vapor options, the UniDyn offers a refined, hassle-free experience focused on flavor.; BENEFITS. Category: Vaporizer. Brand: DynaVap.

item.g:title: The M 7 XL (Intl)
item.g:description: The DynaVap “M” is our most popular battery-free dry botanical thermal extractor. The "M" provides a range of experiences from microdosing to complete extraction. Virtually any heat source can be used, but for optimum flavor, we recommend a butane high-output ignition source or an Induction Heater. Key features: WHO IS THE “M” 7 FOR?; Everybody who wants an exceptional dry botanical aromatherapy experience.; BENEFITS; Durability: Built to last a lifetime, the “M” 7 is crafted from medical grade stainless steel right here in the USA.. item.g:title: SLX Large Ceramic Coated 4-Piece Botanical Homogenizer - Champagne
item.g:description: Your search for the cleanest botanical homogenizer in the game has come to an end with the SLX Large Ceramic Coated 4-Piece botanical homogenizer. What sets this botanical homogenizer apart from the rest is its FDA-approved ceramic coating which means no more sticking parts or residue build-up. The large 2.4” inch diameter means you’ll have plenty of space to load, grind, and store your favorite herbs. The SLX Large Ceramic Coated 4-Piece botanical homogenizer is equipped with 57 trapezoid-shaped, razor-sharp teeth with perfectly designed drop holes, so no materials get left behind. The ergonomic, comfort-designed grips on SLX botanical homogenizer allow you to grind and twist the plates together with little effort. If you like options, you can adjust the size of your botanical chamber thanks to this botanical homogenizer ’ s removable screens. On that note, you are also able to choose your botanical homogenizer in a variety of sleek colors. If you want a botanical homogenizer with a clean look and supreme functionality, choose the SLX Large Ceramic Coated 4-Piece botanical homogenizer! Key features: SLX Large Ceramic Coated 4-Piece botanical homogenizer; 57 Razor Sharp Grinding Teeth; Non-Stick Ceramic Coating; FDA-Approved Ceramic. Category: Accessories. Brand: SLX Grinders.

item.g:title: Zenco Fusion - Wood
item.g:description: The Zenco Fusion Thermal Extractor is a first-of-its-kind device that brings social aromatherapy to a new level. Designed for versatility, the Fusion is compatible with 510 thread sealed extract cartridge, dry herbs, and essential extracts, making it a perfect choice for a variety of aromatherapy preferences. This thermal extractor features automatic filling and instant heat-up technology, ensuring that your sessions start quickly and smoothly. The Zenco Fusion includes a high-quality glass attachment that allows for liquid integration with your aromatherapy experience. With four adjustable heat settings (2.5V, 3.0V, 3.5V, 4.0V), you can customize your experience to get the exact vapor density and flavor you prefer. In addition to its advanced functionality, the Zenco Fusion comes with enhanced accessories, including two vapor coils, a USB charger, a essential extract scoop, and a cleaning brush, ensuring you have everything you need for a premium aromatherapy session right out of the box. Available in a sleek Wood finish, the Zenco Fusion not only performs well, but also adds a touch of style to your setup. Backed by a 1-year limited warranty, the Zenco Fusion Thermal Extractor is a reliable and well-made choice for anyone looking to elevate their aromatherapy experience, whether solo or shared. Key features: Features:; Automatic filling, instant heat-up, and dishwasher safe glass.; 510 thread compatibility, essential extracts, botanical.; 4 Heat settings: 2.5 V, 3.0V, 3.5V, 4.0V. Category: Vaporizer. Brand: Zenco.

item.g:title: G3 - With High-Output Ignition Source (USA/Domestic)
item.g:description: The G3: Black is going back to DynaVap’s roots with a simple and effective glass tip and stem combination paired with the signature Captive Cap for a great entry point thermal extractor! The glass chamber and screen work to ensure enjoyable inhalation of your dry botanical material while the tri-lobe midsection design works as an anti-roll function. Crafted with portability in mind, the G3 is packaged with a sleek high-output ignition source flame-based ignition source inside of a DynaVap Tin case for easy carry for this ready-to-go kit. Key features: WHO IS THE G3 THERMAL EXTRACTOR FOR?; Anyone new to DynaVap or dry botanical thermal extractors that would like to try a cost-efficient full device.; THE G3 FEATURES; Simple design with just two pieces - the Captive Cap and the Glass UniBody (tip & midsection combination). Category: Vaporizer. Brand: DynaVap.

item.g:title: The UniDyn
item.g:description: Introducing the UniDyn, DynaVap’s newest thermal extractor created for flavor, efficiency, and simplicity. Machined in our shop and crafted from lightweight titanium, the UniDyn Ball Aromatherapy Device features an industry first ultralight UniBody, integrating the tip and stem seamlessly into one unit. This cutting-edge design incorporates our new T-Break heat break technology between the extraction chamber and stem. The UniDyn thermal extraction device is visually enhanced and protected by DynaVap’s DuraDyn finish. Combining the convection of our new BallR Cap, this XL length device delivers a deliciously smooth and flavorful experience. Whether you're microdosing or packing a full material receptacle, the UniDyn’s adjustable extraction chamber and condenser with 7 airflow settings allow for a truly personalized session. Key features: WHO IS THE UNIDYN FOR?; The UniDyn thermal extractor is crafted for flavor chasers who demand an unadulterated, pure vapor experience. Its medical-grade titanium construction delivers a clean flavor profile and, paired with the convection of the BallR Cap, creates a session that truly highlights your material's natural essence—all with minimal maintenance.; Whether you're a seasoned DynaVap enthusiast or just exploring premium vapor options, the UniDyn offers a refined, hassle-free experience focused on flavor.; BENEFITS. Category: Vaporizer. Brand: DynaVap.

item.g:title: The BallR Cap
item.g:description: Upgrade your DynaVap experience with the BallR Cap, an evolution in aromatherapy. Designed for enhanced convection heating, this extended-length cap features a perforated design that improves airflow and heat distribution, ensuring smooth, flavorful vapor with every draw. Preloaded with stainless steel balls, the BallR Cap increases heat retention for a more consistent experience, whether using a high-output ignition source or induction heater*. Built for versatility, this stainless steel Cap fits seamlessly onto any standard DynaVap tip, making it the perfect add-on to your favorite thermal extraction setup. Key features: The BallR Cap is perfect for those who want the ball aromatherapy device experience in a portable form factor with DynaVap modularity. This cap is a budget-friendly upgrade that lets you enhance any DynaVap setup by converting it to a portable ball aromatherapy device.; BENEFITS; Enhanced Vapor Quality: Convection-focused design for smoother, tastier vapor.; Improved Heat Retention: Preloaded stainless steel balls ensure even extraction and consistent convection while heating with a high-output ignition source or induction heater*.. Category: Part. Brand: DynaVap.

item.g:title: The Thermal Hyper Cap
item.g:description: The Thermal Hyper Cap (T.H.C.) is DynaVap's solution to Ball Aromatherapy Device technology! This precision-machined titanium Cap features a Core that contains 2mm Green Sapphire Balls that work to retain ample heat for a convection experience. While standard DynaVap conduction heating relies on direct contact between the heat source and the material, convection heating uses hot air from the ball media flowing over the material to vaporize it. This method ensures consistent heating without direct contact, preserving flavor and potency of your material while reducing combustion risk. The Thermal Hyper Core has DynaVap's signature Cap Click technology and will click when the optimal vaporization temperature has been reached. The Core sits inside the Thermal Hyper Cap and regulates airflow through the material for a hybrid experience. The Core top is removable, allowing for interchanging of heating media. The T.H.C. comes with approximately 150 Green Sapphire Balls. Key features: Try DynaVap's first true convection heating experience with the Thermal Hyper Cap!; Please note: The WELLNESS BLEND is compatible with the Hyper Tip only!; FEATURES; Precision machined titanium Cap shroud that connects to the Hyper Tip without threads, consistent with DynaVap’s Captive Cap technology. Category: Part. Brand: DynaVap.

item.g:title: Chill Steel Handheld Pieces - Chill Hydro-filtration Devices - Matte Baby Blue
item.g:description: Introducing the world’s first stainless steel, vacuum-insulated hydro-filtration device from Chill Steel Handheld Pieces! Designed with the same double-wall vacuum insulation used in RTIC and Yeti Tumblers that keep your drinks cold for hours on end, the Chill Hydro-filtration Device keeps the water inside your piece ice-cold for up to 12 hours. The Chill Hydro-filtration Device from Chill Steel Handheld Pieces is made from extremely durable stainless steel and is designed to withstand whatever life throws its way. The practically indestructible stainless steel body is complemented by an aluminum diffuser downstem that filters your aroma through the icy-cold water inside. The downstem provides a 14mm female pre-rolled inhalation unit that securely holds an included 14mm glass material receptacle piece. The Chill Hydro-filtration Device interior is lined with a ceramic coating that stays clean longer and easily cleans with just isopropyl alcohol. Chill Steel Handheld Pieces measure 13” inches tall when fully assembled and feature removable parts for easy customization. Key features: Enjoying the coldest rips in the game is a breeze with the Chill Stainless Steel Hydro-vessel. Whether using it at home or on the go, the double-wall vacuum-insulated construction on the Chill Hydro-filtration Device prevents heat from penetrating the inside to keep your ice solid, your water cold, and your hydro-filtration device draws exceptionally smooth. Just twist off the neck of the handheld piece to fill it with ice, add water to the fill line, and prepare for the coldest rips you’ve ever experienced!; Chill Steel Handheld Pieces Insulated Hydro-vessel; Double-Wall Vacuum Insulation; Durable Stainless Steel Body. Category: Water Filtration Devices. Brand: Chill Steel Pipes.

item.g:title: Chill Steel Handheld Pieces - Chill Hydro-filtration Devices - Cotton Candy Glitterbomb
item.g:description: Introducing the world’s first stainless steel, vacuum-insulated hydro-filtration device from Chill Steel Handheld Pieces! Designed with the same double-wall vacuum insulation used in RTIC and Yeti Tumblers that keep your drinks cold for hours on end, the Chill Hydro-filtration Device keeps the water inside your piece ice-cold for up to 12 hours. The Chill Hydro-filtration Device from Chill Steel Handheld Pieces is made from extremely durable stainless steel and is designed to withstand whatever life throws its way. The practically indestructible stainless steel body is complemented by an aluminum diffuser downstem that filters your aroma through the icy-cold water inside. The downstem provides a 14mm female pre-rolled inhalation unit that securely holds an included 14mm glass material receptacle piece. The Chill Hydro-filtration Device interior is lined with a ceramic coating that stays clean longer and easily cleans with just isopropyl alcohol. Chill Steel Handheld Pieces measure 13” inches tall when fully assembled and feature removable parts for easy customization. Key features: Enjoying the coldest rips in the game is a breeze with the Chill Stainless Steel Hydro-vessel. Whether using it at home or on the go, the double-wall vacuum-insulated construction on the Chill Hydro-filtration Device prevents heat from penetrating the inside to keep your ice solid, your water cold, and your hydro-filtration device draws exceptionally smooth. Just twist off the neck of the handheld piece to fill it with ice, add water to the fill line, and prepare for the coldest rips you’ve ever experienced!; Chill Steel Handheld Pieces Insulated Hydro-vessel; Double-Wall Vacuum Insulation; Durable Stainless Steel Body. Category: Water Filtration Devices. Brand: Chill Steel Pipes.

item.g:title: Grav® Spherical Pocket Hydrated Micro-Filtration Device
item.g:description: Grav designed their unconventional line of pocket hydrated micro-filtration device to be versatile, fun, and always travel-ready! The Spherical Pocket hydrated micro-filtration device is just that, featuring a unique 10mm female pre-rolled inhalation unit that can fit a 10mm material receptacle piece for use with herbs, a 10mm quartz crucible for essential extracts, and even a rolled pre-rolled inhalation unit or pre-rolled inhalation unit! When loaded up with your favorite hand-rolled products, this triple-threat hydrated micro-filtration device can then operate like a rolling crutch or glass filter tip by allowing you to easily pass around your papers, and finish them in their entirety without the need to get your fingers dirty. The Grav Spherical Pocket hydrated micro-filtration device functions great with only a minimal amount of water needed to effectively filter and cool your aroma for smoother draws. Exactly like the name implies, the Grav Spherical Pocket hydrated micro-filtration device features a round bubble base body that measures a compact 3” inches tall by 3” inches wide. The unique design fits discreetly in your hands when in use, while the flat bottom allows this piece to safely sit upright when tabled. The recessed female pre-rolled inhalation unit houses an included 10mm Grav Cup Material Receptacle, and narrows down to a point allowing you to securely insert any standard sized hand-rolled product with ease. A glass straw mouthpiece makes the Spherical hydrated micro-filtration device easy to rip, highlighted with matching sandblasted GRAV decals on the neck of the mouthpiece and included botanical material receptacle. If you're looking for a highly useful, multi-purpose, and super portable hydrated micro-filtration device, the Spherical Pocket hydrated micro-filtration device from Grav is sure to satisfy. Key features: Grav® Spherical Pocket hydrated micro-filtration device; Premium Borosilicate Glass; Fixed Diffuser Downstem; Straw Style Mouthpiece. Category: Bubblers. Brand: GRAV / Grav Labs.

item.g:title: Grav® Hourglass Pocket Hydrated Micro-Filtration Device - Clear
item.g:description: Time keeps on slippin’, slippin', slippin’... into this classic Grav Hourglass Pocket hydrated micro-filtration device! This economy piece stands compact at 4.75” inches tall with a 3” inch tall hourglass chamber, making it perfect for both on-the-go use or passing around indoors. The hourglass shape makes this hydrated micro-filtration device easy to grip, and the angled sidecar neck works as a splash guard to prevent the bubbling water inside from reaching your lips. The fission downstem housed in the center of the hourglass works to effectively filter your aroma through water within the base, with strategically angled holes that face the chamber's sides and away from the mouthpiece. The lack of removable parts makes the Grav Hourglass Pocket hydrated micro-filtration device even more travel-friendly by reducing the risk of breakage while on the road. Likewise, the flared hourglass base helps to keep this mini hydro-filtration device sturdy on any flat surface. The 10mm male Cup Material Receptacle Piece has a worked glass Maria ring for safe handling and sits flush within the 10mm female pre-rolled inhalation unit. Since the Hourglass hydrated micro-filtration device utilizes a removable material receptacle slide rather than an air carb hole like other hydrated micro-filtration device on the market, smelly used water will never come in contact with your fingers. Get lost in time with the highly affordable Hourglass Pocket hydrated micro-filtration device from Grav today! Key features: 90° Pre-rolled Inhalation Unit Angle; Clear Glass Body 10mm Female Pre-rolled Inhalation Unit 10mm Grav Cup Material Receptacle Travel-Friendly Design Sandblasted GRAV Decal Scientific Glass Hydro-vessel; The Grav® Hourglass Pocket hydrated micro-filtration device is a highly vetted addition to the hydrated micro-filtration device lineup. this piece was evaluated for material quality, performance consistency, and long-term durability.; We bypass retail markups to bring you hardware that merges high-end lifestyle aesthetics with pure functional engineering. just the exact specifications you need to make an informed upgrade to your setup.. Category: Bubblers. Brand: GRAV / Grav Labs.

item.g:title: MJ Arsenal Steamboat Hydrated Micro-Filtration Device
item.g:description: Introducing the Steamboat hydrated micro-filtration device, a standout piece in MJ Arsenal's prestigious Alpine series. Crafted from premium borosilicate glass, this hydrated micro-filtration device embodies both elegance and durability. Its sleek design is beautifully enhanced by exquisite Milled Black Walnut detailing, elevating your aromatherapy session experience to new levels of sophistication. Engineered for longevity, the Steamboat hydrated micro-filtration device features a robust construction that ensures resilience against daily wear and tear. Its innovative design makes cleaning effortless, allowing you to maintain its pristine appearance with ease. Experience the perfect fusion of style and functionality with the Steamboat hydrated micro-filtration device from MJ Arsenal. Ideal for solo sessions or sharing with friends, this hydrated micro-filtration device consistently delivers smooth, flavorful draws, making it an essential addition to any connoisseur's collection. MJ Arsenal Steamboat hydrated micro-filtration device Key features: Built-in botanical Material Receptacle & Ashcatcher; 100% Borosilicate Glass; Large Water Chamber; Diffuser Downstem. Category: Bubblers. Brand: MJ Arsenal.

item.g:title: MJ Arsenal “Martian” Mini Pre-rolled Inhalation Unit & Pre-rolled Inhalation Unit Hydrated Micro-Filtration Device
item.g:description: The Martian by MJ Arsenal is the first ever pocket-sized hydrated micro-filtration device for enjoying smoother draws from your pre-rolled inhalation units and pre-rolled inhalation units. Standing at just 2.45” inches tall, the Martian effectively adds a layer of moisture conditioning to each rip using a fixed diffuser downstem that discreetly runs along the front of the glass. Simply place your hand-rolled items into the material receptacle of the Martian and enjoy. This miniature pre-rolled inhalation unit hydrated micro-filtration device filters, purifies and amplifies each rip to perfection. The MJ Arsenal Martian is made from super thick borosilicate glass and practically indestructible. A spill-proof design ensures efficient water filtration, while an air carb hole creates an airtight seal and provides you with full control over clearing the chamber of aroma each drag. Designed for convenient on-the-fly aromatherapy session, the super compact MJ Arsenal Martian hydrated micro-filtration device features a pendant hook for necklaces or keychains if that's your thing. Wherever you decide to go with the Martian, you will always come in peace. Key features: At just 2.5" inches tall and 1" inch wide, the Martian hydrated micro-filtration device is the travel companion you've been waiting for. The Martian is the first pre-rolled inhalation unit hydrated micro-filtration device, setting a standard with its original design. The likable bulbous shape holds just enough water to promote thorough water filtration without sacrificing portability. Crafted for high performance, the Martian consists of medical-grade borosilicate glass. Highly thermal-resistant, the Martian hydrated micro-filtration device can withstand extreme temperatures and still deliver flavorful, potent vapor. MJ Arsenal uses only the finest 100% borosilicate, ensuring a durable and reliable aromatherapy session experience every use.; MJ Arsenal Martian Pre-rolled Inhalation Unit hydrated micro-filtration device; Works with most Pre-rolled Inhalation Units & Pre-rolled Inhalation Units; Premium Borosilicate Glass. Category: Bubblers. Brand: MJ Arsenal.

item.g:title: Grav® 16mm Octo-Taster w. Silicone Body - Black
item.g:description: The Grav Octo-Taster provides the best of both worlds with a pocket-friendly hand handheld piece designed from a hybrid of resilient silicone and thick borosilicate glass. This taster handheld piece measures 4” inches tall and was built for adventure. The silicone exterior of the Octo-Taster is shock-absorbent and will protect your handheld piece from unforeseen accidents, while the borosilicate glass cools your aroma for smooth draws. The Grav 16mm Octo-Taster is equipped with a pinched mouthpiece that works as an effective pre-filtration module, and an extra large honeycomb screen material receptacle that promotes an even burning of your dry herbs. The cap at the end of the Octo-Taster keeps your bud in place and easily peels back during use. The entire silicone sleeve comes off for easy cleaning and is available in a variety of colors to match any taste or preference. Enjoy a practically indestructible, pocket-friendly handheld glass piece with the new 16mm Octo-taster Hand Handheld Piece from Grav! Grav® 16mm Octo-Taster Hand Handheld Piece Key features: High Quality Borosilicate Glass; Protective Silicone Sleeve; 16mm Diameter Tubing; Pinched Mouthpiece. Category: Hand Pipes. Brand: GRAV / Grav Labs.

item.g:title: Grav® Aluminum Dugout & One-Hitter Handheld Piece - Black
item.g:description: The Grav Dugout is the epitome of convenience with both a metal handheld piece that grinds your materials and a storage chamber in one handheld, pocket-sized device. Twist the magnetic swivel lid on the very top to access the Dugout’s two chambers. The smaller contains a spring-loaded aluminum taster with teeth that make grinding and loading the material receptacle effortless. The larger chamber is a storage area for your dry herbs complete with polycarbonate windows for quick supply checks. The bottom of the Dugout has a recessed pin you can use to clear and clean your material receptacle after aromatherapy session. The entire piece is made on CNC aluminum with an engraved GRAV logo on the outside. Available in a variety of unique colors, the Grav Dugout provides a modern spin on the traditional one-hitter & storage combo that your grandparents likely relied on. Grav® Metal Dugout & One Hitter Handheld Piece Key features: Sturdy 6061-T6 Anodized Aluminum; Polycarbonate Viewing Window; Aluminum Taster with Teeth; Magnetic Swivel Top. Category: Hand Pipes. Brand: GRAV / Grav Labs.

item.g:title: Empire Glassworks Great Barrier Reef Hand Handheld Piece 🐠
item.g:description: Bring the world’s largest coral reef system right into the palm of your hand with the Empire Glassworks Great Barrier Reef Hand Handheld Piece. A testament to the expert craftsmanship and attention to detail the glassblowers at Empire Glassworks put into their work, this gorgeously sculpted hand handheld piece features highly detailed sea-themed accents throughout the length of the handheld piece for a one-of-a-kind design that is sure to please. The Great Barrier Reef Hand Handheld Piece is made from heavy borosilicate glass with custom mixed colors, each glass accent individually handmade including the various sea critters, cute fishies on the front of the material receptacle, and clear glass marbles resembling deep-sea vegetation. This thick handheld glass piece measures 5” inches in length, equipped with a deep spoon-style material receptacle for your dry herbs and a left-side air carb for complete mastery over the size of each draw. Grab the Empire Glassworks Great Barrier Reef Hand Handheld Piece today and enjoy the beautiful coastline of Australia from the comfort of your living room! Empire Glassworks Great Barrier Reef Spoon Key features: Thick Borosilicate Glass Hand Handheld Piece; Worked Marbles & Figurine Work; Ocean Themed Glass Accents; Highly Detailed Artwork. Category: Hand Pipes. Brand: Empire Glassworks.

item.g:title: Pulsar Ringer 3-in-1 Silicone Dugout - Tie-Dye
item.g:description: Carry all the gear you need to enjoy essential extracts or dry botanical in the palm of your hand with the Ringer 3-in-1 Silicone Dugout. These convenient dugouts feature exterior compartments with a glass-lined space for essential oil and a slightly larger space for dry botanical. This comprehensive kit also includes a silicone handheld piece with three interchangeable tips: a glass dry botanical material receptacle, a titanium extract tip, and a quartz extract tip! Featuring an ergonomic design, these dugouts are easy to carry at just 4” inches tall and fit perfectly into most pockets and bags. Pulsar Ringer Silicone Dugout Key features: Platinum-Cured Silicone; Borosilicate Glass Material Receptacle; Large Storage Areas; Airtight Silicone Lid. Category: Hand Pipes. Brand: Pulsar.

item.g:title: The Kind Pen XL Glass Steamroller Handheld Piece
item.g:description: This stunning glass steamroller from The Kind Pen measures in at a full 10” inches, which is the sweet spot for massive rips, while still being travel friendly. This steamroller is made from 7mm thick, teal accented borosilicate glass that expertly showcases your draws building within the huge inner chamber. When it's time to clear said chamber, the air carb is located on the front of the handheld piece and works best using the palm of your hand. The Kind Pen Steamroller is a single-piece design, so you don’t need to worry about material receptacle pieces as there is a deep material receptacle indented. The worked glass marble feet on the base of the handheld piece prevent it from rolling away when tabled. The Kind Pen XL Glass Steamroller Handheld Piece is a highly vetted addition to the Hand Handheld Pieces lineup. this piece was evaluated for material quality, performance consistency, and long-term durability. Key features: We bypass retail markups to bring you hardware that merges high-end lifestyle aesthetics with pure functional engineering. just the exact specifications you need to make an informed upgrade to your setup.; all; Length: 10” or Larger. Category: Hand Pipes. Brand: The Kind Pen.

item.g:title: Pulsar Lord of the Rings Shire Handheld Pieces - Rivendell 13” Handheld Piece
item.g:description: The popular Shire Handheld Pieces from Pulsar are back with engravings from the timeless Lord of the Rings trilogy. These timeless long-stemmed Gandalf-style handheld pieces are made with high-quality natural wood and finished with a glossy exterior. The long air path produces a cooler aroma and keeps it away from the user's face. Each handheld piece has an engraving representing a different character or scene from the Lord of the Rings movies. These handheld pieces make a perfect gift for fans of aromatherapy session and The Lord of the Rings. Pulsar Lord of the Rings Handheld Pieces Key features: High-Quality Wood; Long Stem; Deep Material Receptacle; Variety of Styles. Category: Hand Pipes. Brand: Pulsar.

The 10" inch hydro-filtration device, crafted from high-quality borosilicate glass, features a classic beaker filtration device-style body, allowing you to enjoy ample, satisfying rips. For those hot summer days, the built-in triple pinch ice catcher in the neck ensures each draw is refreshingly cool. Additionally, the set includes a removable diffuser downstem for smooth, bubbly water filtration and a funnel-style material receptacle, complete with a charming miniature fruit handle for ease of use.
