item.g:title: Boveda 62% 2-Way Relative Humidity Control Packs (Size 8) - 10-Pack
item.g:description: Once you go Boveda, you’ll never go back. Boveda® Humidity Packs are hands down the easiest way to preserve your dry herbs' freshness & potency while in storage. The 62% Humidity Packs provide the cleanest and most purified humidity available for herbs and will effectively preserve your product's colors, tastes, aroma & potency. World-renowned cigar companies use these simple yet highly beneficial packets to keep their products from drying. The top botanical companies, single-use delivery paper, and pre-rolled inhalation unit wrap brands even use Boveda Humidity Packs to keep their products fresh in storage and during transportation. These same benefits are now available for the everyday person in an 8-gram size perfect for use with your personal stash. How it Works: Key features: Storing dry herbs for extended periods of time will cause them to lose potency and dry out over time. Boveda® humidity packs work by adding or removing moisture as needed to ensure an ideal relative humidity inside your storage container at all times. These humidity control packs in specific will keep your storage containers air at exactly 62% relative humidity, specifically engineered to maintain the perfect moisture levels found in dry herbs, flowers, hemp, and other herbal medicines.; Boveda humidity packs are made up of a saturated solution of water & salt. That’s it! Boveda only consists of 100% pure water vapor and is contained within a permeable package that uses a “reverse osmosis” membrane to release and absorb purified water vapor as needed. Having too much moisture in your storage container runs the risk of possible contamination from mold or mildew. Too little moisture and your plants will dry up and lose their potency. In terms of dry herbs such as hemp and medicinal botanical, Boveda’s moisture retention properties allow botanical to stay properly hydrated and hold onto its trichomes. These trichomes hold the therapeutic benefits exclusive to botanical and allow your plants to retain optimal medicinal effectiveness. Let Boveda Humidity Packs do the balancing act for you by maintaining an ideal relative humidity of 62%, thereby locking in the tastes & efficacy of your dry herbs. If your plants could talk, they’d ask for Boveda!; How to Use:; Super simple to use, add Boveda® Humidity Packs to your TightVacs, stash cans, mason jars, or whatever airtight storage container you plan on using to keep your herbs fresh. No activation needed. Leave it on the bottom, lay it up top, or squeeze it in between; Boveda won't negatively affect your plants through direct contact. Each Boveda pack will last a few months and can be replaced whenever it loses its softness & becomes rigid.. Category: Accessories. Brand: Boveda Inc..

These ultra-thin 1¼” single-use delivery paper are always unbleached and unrefined—you can even see variations in the shade of leaves depending on that years harvest! As if OCB single-use delivery paper weren’t eco-friendly enough, each booklet is printed using vegetable ink on recycled cardboard. Each booklet of OCB 1¼” Organic single-use delivery paper contains 50 papers and the full box contains 24 packs. Snag a pack today and enjoy single-use delivery paper just the way Mother Nature intended! OCB 1.25” Organic single-use delivery paper Key features: High Quality Sourced Ingredients; Unbleached Organic Hemp; 100% Natural Arabic Gum; Recycled Packaging. Category: Accessories. item.g:title: Juicy Jay’s 1.25” Flavored Single-Use Delivery Paper - 24ct Display - Watermelon
item.g:description: Don’t be fooled by generic brands claiming some type of “triple-infused” flavoring process—only Juicy Jay’s Flavored single-use delivery paper are produced with a proprietary “triple-dipped” flavoring system, each as deliciously sweet as they sound. Genuine Juicy Jay’s single-use delivery paper were designed to enhance the natural flavors of your rolled combustible leaf. Each sheet features detailed artwork that depicts your flavor, the designs made from safe & non-toxic soy ink. The variety of unique flavors are never overbearing on the taste of your materials, making these 1.25” inch papers a great choice to roll up your favorite dry herbs. Juicy Jay Papers themselves are made from an all-natural hemp/rice blend for a smooth and easy burn from start to finish. The secret to the delicious taste lies in the painstakingly slow, triple-dipped flavoring system as mentioned above. The process has remained a secret for decades, well-guarded by the factory workers at HBI and their refurbished machines that have been making these papers since the 1960s. That’s the reason Juicy Jay’s are the strongest and tastiest single-use delivery paper around! Each booklet of Juicy Jay’s 1.25” single-use delivery paper are hand packed and contain 32 leaves per pack. Choose from a large variety of mouthwatering flavors and make every roll more pleasurable with these sweet single-use delivery paper from Juicy Jay. Key features: Juicy Jay’s 1.25” Flavored single-use delivery paper; Triple Dipped Flavoring System; Smooth & Easy Burn; Traditional 1¼ Size. Category: Rolling Accessories. Brand: Juicy Jays.

item.g:title: Boveda 62% 2-Way Relative Humidity Control (Size 67) - 10-Pack
item.g:description: Once you go Boveda, you’ll never go back. Boveda® 2-Way Humidity Control Packs are hands down the easiest way to preserve your dry herbs' freshness & potency while in storage. The 62% Humidity Packs provide the cleanest and most purified humidity available for herbs and will effectively preserve your product's colors, tastes, aroma, and potency. World-renowned cigar companies use these simple yet highly beneficial packets to keep their products from drying. The top botanical companies, single-use delivery paper, and pre-rolled inhalation unit wrap brands even use Boveda Humidity Packs to keep their products fresh in storage and during transportation. These same benefits are now available for your personal stash, and these 67 gram packs will provide precise humidity control for up to 1 pound (450 grams) of botanical! How it Works: Key features: Storing dry herbs for extended periods of time will cause them to lose potency and dry out over time. Boveda® humidity packs work by adding or removing moisture as needed to ensure an ideal relative humidity inside your storage container at all times. These humidity control packs in specific will keep your storage containers air at exactly 62% relative humidity, specifically engineered to maintain the perfect moisture levels found in dry herbs, flowers, hemp, and other herbal medicines. Boveda Size 67 is the most versatile for botanical use. When used in smaller jars, this size lasts longer and never over humidifies. When used in 2 Liter storage containers or large turkey bags, you can simply use more packs based on your weight.; Boveda Humidity Packs are made up of a saturated solution of water & salt. That’s it! Boveda only consists of 100% pure water vapor and is contained within a permeable package that uses a “reverse osmosis” membrane to release and absorb purified water vapor as needed. Having too much moisture in your storage container runs the risk of possible contamination from mold or mildew. Too little moisture and your plants will dry up and lose their potency.; In terms of dry herbs such as hemp and medicinal botanical, Boveda’s moisture retention properties allow botanical to stay properly hydrated and hold onto its trichomes. These trichomes hold the therapeutic benefits exclusive to botanical and allow your plants to retain optimal medicinal effectiveness. Let Boveda Humidity Packs do the balancing act for you by maintaining an ideal relative humidity of 62%, thereby locking in the tastes and efficacy of your dry herbs. If your plants could talk, they’d ask for Boveda!; How to Use:. Category: Accessories. Brand: Boveda Inc..

item.g:description: Our Reclaim / Dry Pre-filtration Module is hand-crafted from 100% borosilicate glass for performance and cleanliness. This dual-function accessory captures resin and ash, ensuring a clog-free desktop filtration apparatus and reducing the need for regular cleaning. Our novel device features a removable 18mm to 10mm insert, allowing for various size quartz options and providing TRUE accessibility for users who prefer reloading their buckets with reclaimed oil on the go. With this unique accessory, you can efficiently recycle your extracts and keep your desktop filtration apparatuses and hydro-vessels pristine like never before. As an pre-filtration module, it traps byproducts before they enter your essential extract filtration system, adds extra water filtration to cool down the aroma, and safeguards your desktop filtration apparatus from heat damage. As a reclaim catcher, it collects leftover oil (reclaim) after extracting, keeping your desktop filtration apparatus clean and the reclaim ready for reuse. Its detachable cup allows easy collection and recycling of these sticky substances. Upgrade your setup with this Reclaim / Dry Pre-filtration Module for enhanced performance and easy maintenance. item.g:title: The Kind Pen Giggles Hydro-filtration Device
item.g:description: The Giggles is the perfect addition to any hydro-filtration device enthusiast's collection, offering smooth and powerful draws. This 12â€ inch hydro-vessel features a unique vase body that is thin at the top and becomes wider at the base, making it stable on flat surfaces. The chamber is equipped with an inline perc which diffuses your aroma into many bubbles, and a turbine perc which further filters your aroma for two layers of effective percolation. Even with all the bubbles and percolation, you can rest assured that the Giggles design will prevent any splashback from reaching your mouth. The Giggles Hydro-vessel comes with a 14mm male funnel material receptacle which sits on a fixed downstem. Between the unique design, double percs, and cool accents, this hydro-filtration device is sure to offer high satisfaction. item.g:title: Grav Monarch Gravity Hydro-filtration Device
item.g:description: Introducing the all-new GRAV Monarch Gravity Hydro-filtration Device, a pinnacle of design and sophistication. Crafted from premium borosilicate glass, this masterpiece boasts a distinctive and refined aesthetic. The Monarch Gravity Hydro-filtration Device offers both style and functionality, adorned with substantial scalloping along its sides and featuring a graceful curve for enhanced handling. Its user-friendly mouthpiece ensures an effortlessly pleasant aromatherapy session experience; each inhale is a gratifying moment of comfort. Beneath its captivating exterior lies impressive power, rivaling that of the Gravitron. The generously proportioned glass body fills with dense aroma, while the intricate scalloped glass detailing elevates your aromatherapy session to one of class and distinction. Indulge in a sense of elevation and tranquility that only the Monarch Gravity Hydro-filtration Device can provide. Navigating the realm of the gravity hydro-filtration device is a breeze. item.g:title: Prism Handheld Pieces Pyramid Perc Beaker Filtration Device Hydro-filtration Device - Showerhead Perc (20" inches) / Blueberry & White
item.g:description: The Prism Handheld Pieces Pyramid Perc beaker filtration device Hydro-filtration Device is built for massive, smooth rips and is made from thick borosilicate glass. This large and in-charge hydro-vessel features an unmistakable pyramid perc within the beaker filtration device base that takes your aroma from the fixed downstem and spreads it out through tiny slits lining the diameter of the base. This style percolator resembles a much larger version of a showerhead perc, providing a very thorough first layer of diffusion for filtering big rips through water. The best part is this modular hydro-filtration device is it can break down for easy cleaning and travel. The massive straight neck was built to hold copious amounts of ice for extra cold rips, complete with a flared mouthpiece on top for easy handling. This modular hydro-filtration device comes with a Colored Tall Mouthpiece, a 7mm thick beaker filtration device Base, an 18mm Male Material Receptacle Slide, and a Colored Halo Connector. If you are looking for a bigger size and more filtration, go with the Showerhead Perc model, which adds another few inches with its perc attachment and additional halo. item.g:title: Stundenglass Kompact Gravity Handheld Piece - Black
item.g:description: Completely innovating the gravity hydro-filtration device game, the Stundenglass Kompact Gravity Handheld Piece has taken an age-old method of aromatherapy session and turned it into a stunningly attractive and highly efficient device. No more water spillage or fumbling with exposed holes that lose your precious aroma--all of the water in the Kompact Gravity Hydro-filtration Device is contained within two globes that sit perched atop a patented, sturdy metal base. The Stundenglass Kompact is a travel-ready alternative to the original Stundenglass Gravity Handheld Piece, but dont let its size fool you. The smaller glass globes and downsized frame still provide the same legendary draws that made this piece so prestigious! Stundenglass set out to create a perfect gravity hydro-filtration device that pushes aroma out for you, rather than using a shared mouthpiece like every other handheld glass piece. The Stundenglass Kompact Gravity Handheld Piece features a unique aesthetic with customizable parts and a simple-to-use design. The patented design requires no battery or motor, just a simple 180° rotation that uses gravity to light your materials. Some materials such as shisha require coals to continue burning, so a partial turn will create the perfect amount of suction to keep your coals lit while providing consistently rich & smooth hookah draws. Key features: Once you fill the Stundenglass chamber with aroma, rotate 180° again for a smooth flow of aroma that pours out the mouthpiece or hookah hose attachment. The potency & strength of your aroma depends on how far you decide to flip the unit over, using gravity to control the ignition of materials and output of aroma. This gravity hydro-filtration devices special design allows you to take as little or as much aroma as you want. Unleash the true power of gravity for a full chamber of aroma or pause it and share with friends by turning the Kompact chamber parallel to your tabletop.; The Stundenglass Kompact Gravity Handheld Piece is great for solo use or equally well with large groups. This rotating gravity hydro-filtration device was engineered to hold the perfect volume of aroma to allow for inhalation of the entire chamber if youre up for it. The versatile design effectively eliminates the need for sharing the same mouthpiece with multiple users, with no mouth-to-mouthpiece contact necessary whatsoever. Theres no need to remove the material receptacle piece at any time either, another first of its kind. The sturdy metal base sports a single arm that allows for easy access to the mouthpiece and the globes while spinning them around.; The Stundenglass Kompact Gravity Hydro-filtration Device was built with durability in mind, made with anodized aircraft-grade aluminum, surgical grade stainless steel, and high-quality Teflon seals. The pill-shaped globes smoothly flip in either direction without tangling the included accessories for a simple and easy-to-use handheld piece that will last you a lifetime. The Stundenglass Kompact will arrive completely ready to go inside a high-grade fabric travel case which includes the patented metal stand, 2 clear glass Kompact globes, a dry botanical material receptacle, hookah material receptacle, coal tray, and hookah hose. Get your hands on one of these infamous gravity hydro-filtration devices and start aromatherapy session like your favorite enthusiast celeb Seth Rogen with the one & only Stundenglass Kompact Gravity Hydro-filtration Device!; How To Use:. Category: Water Filtration Devices. Brand: Stündenglass.

item.g:description: The Grav Empress Hydro-vessel will become the crown jewel of your collection, perfect for both special and casual occasions alike. This stately and statuesque hydro-vessel stands at 13” inches tall and is the latest addition to Grav's evolving lineup of premier hydro-vessels. item.g:description: The elegant Lotus hydro-filtration device will instantly mesmerize you with its colorful floral designs and tasty floral draws. My Bud Vase created this vase-style hydro-vessel to mimic the Lotus botanical’s symbol of perseverance, purity, and hope during challenging times. The hydro-vessel itself measures 8” inches tall by 3” inches wide, while the tray measures 13” inches long by 7.5” inches wide, leaving plenty of space for the included red lotus candle holder and any ground-up botanical you plan to aroma. To take a draw from the My Bud Vase Lotus Hydro-filtration Device, pack your materials inside the included purple glass bubble material receptacle and pull the entire material receptacle slide out of the hydro-filtration device when ready to inhale. item.g:title: Grav Medium Gravitron Gravity Hydro-filtration Device
item.g:description: The legendary Grav Gravitron gravity hydro-filtration device has remained the most ruthless yet efficient aromatherapy session device on the market for a reason and just got a facelift. The Gravitron is the world’s first-ever all-glass gravity hydro-filtration device, and this new and improved version boasts a fivefold increase in glass thickness for more durability than its predecessor. Rather than using the custom 12mm Gravitron accessories of the past if things break, the Gravitron 2.0 is equipped with a 14mm female pre-rolled inhalation unit so you can use your own 14mm material receptacle pieces and other accessories without the need to reorder specific parts. The Gravitron 2.0 also received an upgraded platinum-cured silicone grommet for a tighter seal. Additionally, the interior bottle was redesigned with a more powerful look, and a flange at the top of the neck provides a more ergonomic grip that makes lifting the bottle on each draw a breeze. The Gravitron is the first affordable all-glass gravity hydro-filtration device ever made and a true crowd-pleaser for everyone from an entry-level aromatherapy user to aficionado toker. Constructed from high-grade borosilicate glass, the Gravitron is the first gravity hydro-filtration device you won’t need to hide away while entertaining guests. A rubber seal lines the base perimeter of the inside bottle, preventing glass-on-glass contact for a seamless user experience. If accidents do happen, all parts are affordable and easy to replace. The Medium Gravitron is the smaller version of Grav’s namesake gravity hydro-filtration device, standing at 9.5” inches tall, and this party handheld piece is still as much fun to use and hard-hitting as when it was invented back in 2004. Key features: The Medium Gravitron Gravity Hydro-filtration Device is super easy to use. Start by filling the base about halfway with water until the water level is just below the Gravitron decal. Place the bottle inside the base and pack the included 14mm material receptacle slide with your favorite dry herbs. Begin lighting your material receptacle while slowly pulling the bottle upwards at the same time. Gravity will cause the material receptacle to self-ignite as you continue pulling upwards, and the inner bottle will fill with aroma the higher you pull it. Finally, remove the material receptacle from the bottle and inhale from the mouthpiece as you lightly push the interior bottle back down into the water. This movement creates a pressurized flow of aroma that results in powerful, robust draws. Get yourself a gravity hydro-filtration device you’ll be proud to keep on display with the Medium Gravitron Gravity Hydro-filtration Device today!; Grav® Medium Gravitron Gravity Hydro-filtration Device; First Grav Labs Product Created; Platinum-Cured Silicone Lining. Category: Water Filtration Devices. Brand: GRAV / Grav Labs.

item.g:title: Rokin Thunder XL 510-Threaded Battery - Black
item.g:description: Building on the success of the original Thunder, the Thunder XL takes performance to the next level with a wider design, a digital display, and a host of new features. Now with a 14mm width, it's perfect for larger, fatter sealed extract cartridge, ensuring a perfect fit and more reliable performance. The Thunder XL also boasts an upgraded battery and a sleek digital display, so you’ll always know exactly what voltage you're using and how much battery life you have left—no more guessing! Equipped with both push-button and auto-draw activation, the Thunder XL offers ultimate convenience and flexibility for a smoother aromatherapy experience. It features adjustable voltage settings ranging from 2.0V to 4.0V, in 0.1V increments, and includes Rokin's exclusive Powerwave™ Technology, which ensures consistent, smooth draws and prevents burning your sealed extract cartridge. Plus, its digital preheat function gives you a precise 15-second countdown, making it easier than ever to get the perfect draw right out of the box. With its impressive battery life, customizable settings, and user-friendly design, the Thunder XL is the go-to choice for anyone seeking a top-tier, hassle-free aromatherapy experience. With a sleek rectangular design and convenient flip-top opening, this innovative thermal extractor features a narrow chute for a perfectly concealable sealed extract cartridge. It comes with magnetic adapters for both 0.5mL and 1.0mL 510 threaded extract cartridge, making it easy to secure your sealed extract cartridge inside. To activate the thermal extractor, simply press the large button 5 times and choose between auto-draw functionality or one button control. The 650mAh battery offers 3 voltage settings to suit your preferences, and a 15 second pre-heat function helps prevent clogs for smooth draws. When you're finished, press the button 5 times to turn the device off. What sets the Pulsar VLT apart is its built-in electric flame-based ignition source, providing a wind-proof and butane-free alternative to lighting a pre-rolled inhalation unit. item.g:description: Experience the innovative design of the Pulsar 510 DL 3.0 Twist Auto-Draw Aromatherapy Device Pen, where discretion meets precision. This variable voltage aromatherapy device boasts a sleek exterior for easy concealment while traveling. Building upon previous models, the 510 DL 3.0 offers a slim profile for improved grip and a larger body to accommodate a battery with twice the power of the original DL. Enjoy longer aromatherapy device sessions with fewer charges, thanks to the increased battery capacity. The auto-draw functionality mimics a traditional disposable aromatherapy device, allowing for effortless toking without the need for any buttons. Turning the unit on is as simple as a sequence of quick pulls. The new tactile twist dial offers four voltage settings, catering to all preferences whether you desire intense flavors or dense clouds. item.g:title: Kind Pen Mist 2.0 Sealed Extract Cartridge Thermal Extractor 🔋 - Black
item.g:description: Experience the freedom to stay lifted wherever you go with this portable device that delivers powerful draws. The Mist 2.0 is one of The Kind Pens’ smallest and most portable thermal extractors. This pocket-friendly thermal extractor battery is designed for waxy oil aromatherapy and features 510 threading, making it compatible with pre-filled essential extract or WELLNESS BLEND sealed extract cartridge. The open-face, open-top design of The Kind Pen Mist 2.0 Thermal Extractor ensures a clear view of your oil levels at all times, and the battery fits nearly any 510-threaded sealed extract cartridge, depending solely on width. As with nearly all of The Kind Pens’ products, quality is paramount. The Kind Pen Mist 2.0 is crafted from durable materials and straightforward electronic components, ensuring a reliable thermal extractor battery. The Mist 2.0 offers three different voltage settings to suit nearly any aromatherapy style. Each heat setting is indicated by a color-coded light system and can be quickly adjusted using simple single-button controls. The compact size of The Kind Pen Mist 2.0, paired with the lowest voltage setting, allows for stealthy use when out in public. Key features: The Kind Pen Mist 2.0 Thermal Extractor is so compact that it easily fits in the palm of your hand. The battery capacity is sufficient to last most users a full day of aromatherapy on the medium voltage setting. The Mist 2.0 Thermal Extractor Kit comes with a USB-C charger and is also compatible with the Lightning iPhone charger. Choose from 3 stylish colors and aromatherapy device with the stealth of a ninja using the Kind Pen Mist sealed extract cartridge Thermal Extractor!; The Kind Pen Mist 2.0 sealed extract cartridge Aromatherapy Device; Fits Standard Pre-Filled sealed extract cartridge; 510-Thread Thermal Extractor Battery 🔋. Category: Thermal Extraction Devices. Brand: The Kind Pen.

item.g:title: Kind Pen Covert 2.0 Sealed Extract Cartridge Thermal Extractor 🔋 - Black
item.g:description: Introducing the improved variable voltage aromatherapy device, perfect for discreet, on-the-go usage. This popular model from Kind Pen is a draw among aromatherapy users who enjoy nicotine liquids or WELLNESS BLEND/WELLNESS BLEND sealed extract cartridge but prefer a low-key aromatherapy experience. The Covert 2.0 boasts a 900mAh battery, a user-friendly LCD display, and is available in 5 stylish colors. With three temperature settings, a rapid preheat function, and compatibility with 2G sealed extract cartridge, the Covert 2.0 is truly the ultimate aromatherapy device. As the most covert thermal extractor from The Kind Pen, it features a closed-body design that fully protects your sealed extract cartridge from damage. It is compatible with.5, 1ml, and 2ml sealed extract cartridge, making it a versatile choice for any thermal extraction. Made with durable materials and simple electronic components, the Covert ensures a consistent aromatherapy experience every time. item.g:title: Ritual Cloak Sealed Extract Cartridge Thermal Extractor - White
item.g:description: The Ritual Cloak 510 Battery is a premium choice for aromatherapy enthusiasts, offering a blend of high-quality construction and advanced technology. This variable voltage 510 battery is tailored for optimal compatibility with various 510 sealed extract cartridge, making it a versatile option for different aromatherapy styles. It features three finely tuned voltage settings, each engineered to deliver the best possible flavor-to-vapor ratio, setting it apart from other batteries in the market. What makes The Cloak stand out is its conceal style design, which comfortably fits up to 2g sealed extract cartridge. It includes a USB-C charging cable and boasts a rapid charging feature, powering up fully in just 20-30 minutes. Additionally, The Cloak comes with a Sesh Mode/Pre-Heat function, further enhancing the aromatherapy experience. Its temperature settings are thoughtfully adjusted: Green for more flavor with less vapor, Yellow for a balanced flavor and vapor, and Red for a higher voltage setting, offering flexibility to suit individual preferences. The optimized airflow of the battery is designed to produce thick, milky rips, making each session with The Cloak a satisfying aromatherapy experience. item.g:title: The Grateful Dead x G Pen Dash Thermal Extractor
item.g:description: Crafted in collaboration with Grenco Science, iconic rock band Grateful Dead has taken an unprecedented leap into the botanical industry with The Grateful Dead G Pen Dash Thermal Extractor. Fully customized throughout, The Grateful Dead’s universally recognized red and blue, this limited-edition release is both visually stunning and revolutionary in functionality, like the original Dash Thermal Extractor. The Grateful Dead G Pen Dash features a glass-glazed, stainless steel heating chamber situated within a durable aluminum alloy body. A rechargeable 950mAh battery provides unprecedented power and is equipped with three preset temperature settings (375°F/190°C, 401°F/205°C, and 428°F/220°C). Combined with a clean air source and integrated air path, you’ll experience unsurpassed flavor and vapor production from your favorite strains. Key features: The Grateful Dead G Pen Dash fits in nearly any size pocket and is perfect for on-the-go aromatherapy. Other standout elements include an ergonomically designed chamber opening for convenient loading and a magnetically attached mouthpiece that can be taken apart for easy cleaning & maintenance. The Grateful Dead G Pen Dash also features haptic feedback that vibrates when it’s ready and a smart button with three LED lights to indicate heat level & battery life. With pass-through charging capability via Micro-USB that allows you to continue aromatherapy even while the device is plugged in and an automatic shut-off that preserves battery life when you forget, The Grateful Dead G Pen Dash maximizes usability on every charge.; The Grateful Dead x G Pen Dash Thermal Extractor; Glass-Glazed Stainless Steel Oven; Durable Aluminum Alloy Body. Category: Vaporizer Pen. Brand: Grenco Science.

Meticulously rebuilt from the ground up, the Carrots Boost EVO Thermal Extractor effectively incorporates Dr. Dabber’s proprietary e-desktop filtration apparatus technology centered around the goal of providing the perfect extract. Achieving the perfect extract every single time you use your thermal extractor is a metric that other companies often overlook. While most electric essential extract filtration system thermal extractors on the market have limited temperature controls and are built to continuously heat up until a certain point in time when it cuts off, the Carrots Boost Evo features a patent-pending built-in temperature control sensor that regulates heating, unlike any other thermal extractor we’ve seen before. The engineers at Dr. Dabber chose the preset heat settings with customer feedback from tens of thousands of Boost users, so you can always rely on your Carrots Boost EVO to be consistent and accurate. Pair that technology with a magnetic quartz dish atomizer, all-glass vapor pathway, borosilicate glass water filtration attachment, interchangeable glass accessories, spectacular RGB ambient lighting, and a surprisingly long battery life that offers over 60 draws on a single charge. The Dr. Dabber Boost EVO Carrots Edition is truly the next generation electric essential extract filtration system.; The Dr. Dabber Boost EVO Carrots Edition is slightly larger than the original Boost and Boost Black edition thermal extractors and looks more like a hybrid between the Boost and their larger desktop unit, the Dr. Dabber Switch. The unit's base measures 4” inches tall by 3” inches wide and stands about 8” inches tall. The sides are finished with grip pads for enhanced ergonomics and are ready for an adventure with a limited edition Carrots Travel Bag. item.g:title: Kind Pen Pure Sealed Extract Cartridge Thermal Extractor - Black
item.g:description: It’s true what they say, good things come in small packages. The Kind Pen Pure Thermal Extractor proves that great features come in tiny aromatherapy devices. The Pure features advanced functionality for discreet, convenient on-the-go aromatherapy. It comes with a tank with a ceramic coil in case you would like to fill it yourself, or you can use any standard 510-threaded sealed extract cartridge. You can cycle between four voltages using the simple single-button control or preheat with two clicks for instant draws. Small but formidable, the Pure aromatherapy device makes aromatherapy both travel-friendly and stealthy while retaining the dynamic temperature control of larger handheld thermal extractors. 510 Thread Thermal Extractor Battery 🔋 Key features: The Kind Pen Pure Thermal Extractor; Fits Pre-Filled sealed extract cartridge; Pre-Heating Function; Auto Draw Function. item.g:title: Kind Pen Premium Slim Oil Thermal Extractor - Gold
item.g:description: Enjoy aromatherapy oils and e-liquids? Well, the Premium Slim Oil Aromatherapy Device Pen can do both! Produced by The Kind Pen, this portable thermal extractor has a wickless chamber that can be filled with either e-liquid or oil. That being said, it’s only capable of aromatherapy more liquefied material and not any sticky or viscous substances. Built with user-friendliness in mind, the Slim Oil Aromatherapy Device Pen has a single button, which turns the device on and off, allows for pre-heating, and activates the battery once pressed. When the battery eventually runs out, restore its power by unscrewing the top half of the pen and screwing the bottom portion into the USB charger. Plug the charger into any USB port to begin charging. Apart from the battery's modern technology, this dual-use thermal extractor also produces very flavorful vapor due to its wickless tank. The Premium Slim Oil Aromatherapy Device Pen’s modern aesthetic, coupled with its brilliant functionality, makes this choice a no-brainer. Key features: The Kind Pen Premium Slim Oil Aromatherapy Device Pen; 510-Thread Thermal Extractor Battery 🔋 Pre-Heat Functionality Lithium-Ion Battery Wickless Tank USB Charging Discreet & Pocket-Friendly Portable Oil Thermal Extractor Pen Variable Voltage (2.4v, 2.8v, 3.2v); Box Includes:; 1 x The Kind Pen Premium Slim Oil Aromatherapy Device. Category: Vaporizer Pen. Brand: The Kind Pen.

item.g:title: The Kind Pen Premium Slim Essential Oil Thermal Extractor Pen - Gun Metal
item.g:description: The Premium Slim Essential Oil Pen from The Kind Pen boasts customizable temperatures and a superior quartz atomizer than its more affordable basic version. Designed for aromatherapy essential oil, the Premium Slim Essential Oil Aromatherapy Device Pen utilizes a quartz atomizer with dual ceramic rods and titanium coils that sit inside a quartz heating chamber. One of the primary benefits of having a quartz heating chamber is that it is more flavorful and vaporizes essential extracts more evenly. Apart from the ceramic composition of the atomizer, another integral technological feature of the Premium Slim Essential Oil Thermal Extractor Pen is its 5-click power on and off, which ensures that the device will not activate unintentionally. When your battery is running low, unscrew the entire top portion of the pen, screw it into the charger, and plug it into a USB port. Since it is 510-threaded, you can also attach your favorite sealed extract cartridge making this nifty pen dual compatible with essential extracts and oils. Be kind to your essential oil by adding the Premium Slim Essential Oil Thermal Extractor to your collection! Key features: The Kind Pen Premium Slim Essential Oil Pen; Quartz Heating Chamber; Titanium Coil Atomizer; Shiny Finish. Category: Vaporizer Pen. Brand: The Kind Pen.

item.g:description: The Breezy is a miniature but magical auto-draw thermal extractor for enjoying waxy oils & standard 510-thread essential extract sealed extract cartridge on the go. With four different temperature settings to effectively vaporize materials with different consistencies, the Breezy thermal extractor delivers potent draws as soon as you inhale. Its simple but stylish look comes in a variety of colors to match anyone’s preferences. item.g:title: The Kind Pen Lobi Extract Pen Thermal Extractor - Black

item.g:title: The Kind Pen OG Jams Thermal Extractor - Carbon Fiber
item.g:description: The OG Jams is a portable dry botanical aromatherapy device with superior technology that The Kind Pen is known for. The OG Jams Thermal Extractor delivers smooth, tasty vapor with a ceramic botanical chamber, precise temperature control, and a glass mouthpiece. It measures 4.5” inches long, so it is able to house a one-gram chamber and a large battery for sessions lasting 3-4 hours. The frame of the OG Jams is also very durable and can handle drops with minimal damage. The OG Jams thermal extractor boasts a medical-grade ceramic oven with an exceptionally large capacity for longer sessions and fewer reloads. Unlike most portable aromatherapy devices, the OG Jams features precision temperature control, enabling users to toggle to a precise temperature that's ideal for their botanical strain or preferred vapor profile. The Kind Pen OG Jams features a simple interface with arrow buttons and an LED display showing temperature, battery life, and more. The Kind Pen OG Jams comes with a hydro-vessel adapter, allowing you to water-filter your dry botanical thermal extractor rips, making draws even smoother. Key features: The Kind Pen OG Jams Thermal Extractor; OLED Screen Interface Display; Ceramic Heating Chamber; 2000mAh Battery. Category: Portable Vaporizer. Brand: The Kind Pen.

The mouthpiece screws into a discreet chamber in the Deezy battery where you can load.3g of your botanical. Once you start to heat the thermal extractor, the haptic feedback alerts you when the Deezy is ready for action. Palm-sized & light as a feather, the Deezy enables a convenient and portable aromatherapy experience. Its simple but stylish look comes in a variety of cheerful colors with a sleek, Deezy decal as a stamp of authenticity. Kind Pen Deezy Thermal Extractor Key features: Threaded Mouthpiece; 1100mAh Battery; USB Charging; Durable Body. Category: Portable Vaporizer. Brand: The Kind Pen.

item.g:title: Kind Pen Jiggy 3-in-1 Thermal Extractor - Gold
item.g:description: Get Jiggy with a device that has not one, not two, but three different functions for vaporizing your materials. The Jiggy 3 in 1 thermal extractor from The Kind Pen functions as an electric extract straw, a 510 sealed extract cartridge thermal extractor, and a essential oil pen. This discreet thermal extractor looks exactly like a pen and includes a cap for the ceramic extract tip that doubles as a mouthpiece. Simply remove the cap, select your heat, insert the ceramic tip in your extract container, and use the single-button control to activate the device while inhaling. If you prefer to vaporize your essential oil in a concealed environment, the Jiggy has you covered with its 510-threaded essential oil atomizer. Remove the mouthpiece, screw in the atomizer, and load a small extract into the chamber. After reattaching the mouthpiece, click the button and inhale a flavorful and thick rip of essential extracts. If you prefer to aromatherapy device sealed extract cartridge, the atomizer can be switched with a 510-threaded sealed extract cartridge. Key features: The Jiggy Thermal Extractor has 4 preset temperatures, so you can adjust the heat level to match the consistency of your essential extracts or oils. This thermal extractor also has a preheat function which helps to get the device warmed up for your session. It is constructed with a solid metal exterior for clumsy aromatherapy users who are worried about physical damage. This 3-in-1 thermal extractor comes with a.5ml tank, quartz atomizer, loading tool, handheld piece cleaners, extra o-rings, and a USB charger. Save some money and consolidate your aromatherapy device collection with the Jiggy 3-in-1 Thermal Extractor from The Kind Pen!; 4 Preset Heat Settings Pre-Heating Function USB Charging Simple to Use Travel-Friendly 400mAh Battery Quartz Atomizer Ceramic Atomizer Tip Electronic Direct Draw Straw; *Caution: The Kind Pen Jiggy ceramic tip gets very hot. Use the cap to store when finished.; The Kind Pen Jiggy 3-in-1 Thermal Extractor is a highly vetted addition to the Accessories lineup. this piece was evaluated for material quality, performance consistency, and long-term durability.. Category: Accessories. Brand: The Kind Pen.

item.g:title: Kind Pen Mist Sealed Extract Cartridge Thermal Extractor - Gold
item.g:description: Stay lifted wherever you go with a portable device that packs powerful draws. The Mist is one of The Kind Pens’ smallest and most portable thermal extractors. This pocket-friendly thermal extractor battery is designed for waxy oil aromatherapy and features 510 threading for use with pre-filled essential extract or WELLNESS BLEND sealed extract cartridge. The open-face, open-top design of The Kind Pen Mist Thermal Extractor provides a clear view of your oil levels at all times, and the battery fits nearly any 510-threaded sealed extract cartridge, solely dependent on width. As with nearly all of The Kind Pens’ products, quality is at the forefront. The Kind Pen Mist is made of durable materials and straightforward electronic components for an always reliable thermal extractor battery. The Mist has 3 different voltage settings to accommodate nearly any aromatherapy style. Each heat setting is indicated by a color-coded light system and can be quickly adjusted using simple single-button controls. The small size of The Kind Pen Mist paired with the lowest voltage setting allows for stealthy use when out in public. Key features: The Kind Pen Mist Thermal Extractor is so compact that it can easily fit within the palm of your hand. The battery capacity is enough to last most users a full day of aromatherapy on the medium voltage setting. The Mist Thermal Extractor Kit comes with a USB charger and a.5ml wickless tank to fill with your preferred oils. item.g:title: G Pen Hyer E-Nail Thermal Extractor
item.g:description: Toss the dangerous high-output ignition source and get an e-nail that produces thick and flavorful vapor at the perfect temperatures. The G Pen Hyer Thermal Extractor is a portable e-nail compatible with all female pre-rolled inhalation unit hydro-vessels. This allows you to harness water filtration wherever you go resulting in an ultra-smooth and satisfying aromatherapy experience. A 14mm pre-rolled inhalation unit attachment comes standard with this e-nail; the 10mm and 18mm are sold separately. G Pen can be broken down easily and comes with a travel case with multiple compartments, making it one of the most travel-friendly e-nails in the game. Like all G Pen products, the Hyer was produced with the highest quality materials and features a full quartz tank for best-in-class flavor and vapor production. The essential extract tank is heated by a stainless steel heating element. It features a full quartz chamber and internal up-stem that provides maximum surface area for heating, efficient airflow, and optimal vaporization of essential extracts. For those who prefer aromatherapy botanical, you’re in luck as the Hyer is dual compatible. The Hyer dry botanical Chamber is available as an add-on and can be purchased separately. Key features: The 6000mAh battery holds its charge for many sessions and has smart heating technology with constant temperature output. The Hyer has a three-button control system and five different temperature settings indicated by the LED interface. This allows you to match your temps to all types of essential extract consistencies and set your e-nail to low or high temps depending on if you favor more flavor or thicker rips. The Hyer battery is connected to the heating element through a durable braided power cable with magnetic attachments. The tank cap has two air holes for superior airflow and can be twisted to vaporize your essential extracts evenly. The cap also has a slot for your essential oil tool, so you never misplace it, no matter how high the Hyer gets you. Go with an e-nail that will provide an uncompromising extracting experience with the G Pen Hyer Thermal Extractor!; G Pen Hyer E-Nail Thermal Extractor; Five Pre-Set Temperatures; High-Grade Quartz Tank. Category: Electric Rig / E-Nail. Brand: Grenco Science.

item.g:title: Wulf Mods Orbit Essential Oil Thermal Extractor Pen - Black & Green
item.g:description: The Wulf Mods Orbit Essential Oil Thermal Extractor delivers flavorful clouds that are out of this world. This portable aromatherapy device pen is perfect for essential oil connoisseurs that are always on the go. It features a 1700mAh battery to enjoy continuous sessions on a single charge. When it is time to charge, the USB-C capabilities will have your Orbit back up and running in no time. The Wulf Mods Orbit is unique as it imitates a quartz crucible and includes two quartz terp pearls that spin with each rip to ensure even heat distribution. The Orbit silicone mouthpiece rests comfortably on your lips and connects to a vortex chamber that sits atop the coilless quartz cup. The Orbit Essential Oil Pen has a 10-second heat-up time and three heat settings that can be easily adjusted with its single-button controls. With its colorful designs and outstanding features, the Orbit Essential Extract Thermal Extractor Pen will be the perfect companion for your next extract mission. Key features: Wulf Mods Orbit Thermal Extractor Pen; Stainless Steel Construction; Glass Vortex Chamber; Coilless Quartz Cup. Category: Vaporizer Pen. Brand: Wulf Mods.

item.g:title: Wulf Mods Flora Thermal Extractor - Black & Green
item.g:description: The Flora Thermal Extractor from Wulf Mods effectively extracts all of the flavors from your botanical without any harshness with its detachable ceramic filter. This affordable handheld thermal extractor comes in a variety of Wulf Mods signature designs and colors to stand out from the rest. The Flora was constructed with a tough aluminum body and an OLED display so you can monitor the battery life and adjust your temperatures. It comes with five preset temperature settings ranging from 356°F to 428°F, so start on a low setting if you are a flavor seeker and turn it up to level five if you like big clouds. The Flora has haptic feedback to alert you when your aromatherapy device is ready for use. The 1000mAh battery ensures long-lasting sessions and the USB-C capability charges your device in no time. Go with the Wuld Mods Flora for a hip handheld aromatherapy device that does it all! Wulf Mods Flora dry botanical Thermal Extractor Key features: Durable Aluminum Alloy Body; Detachable Ceramic Filter; Integrated Heating Path; Magnetic Mouthpiece. Category: Vaporizer Pen. Brand: Wulf Mods.

item.g:description: The Rokin Mini Tank H2O combines the portability of the Mini Tank Thermal Extractor and the water filtration of a hydro-filtration device to provide a smooth and flavorful aromatherapy experience. The Mini Tank H2O Thermal Extractor includes removable 10mm and 14mm male adapters to connect your thermal extractor directly to your favorite glass hydro-vessels. These are male pre-rolled inhalation unit adapters, so they will only fit hydro-filtration devices with a 10mm or 14mm female pre-rolled inhalation unit. The Rokin Mini Tank H2O features a spring-loaded 510-thread connection at the top for connecting pre-filled sealed extract cartridge and works with or without the glass adapters as a standalone aromatherapy device pen. This aromatherapy device pen comes has a 500mAh battery that lasts for multiple sessions and rapid USB-C charging to get your thermal extractor up and running in no time. The Rokin Mini Tank H2O Thermal Extractor provides an excellent aromatherapy experience whether you are traveling, partying, or just chilling at home! Rokin Mini Tank H2O Thermal Extractor Battery 🔋 Key features: Designed for Pre-Filled sealed extract cartridge; Fits 0.5ml & 1.0ml sealed extract cartridge; 4 Preset Heat Settings; Fast USB-C Charging. Category: Vape Battery for Cartridges. Brand: Rokin Vapes.

item.g:title: Rokin Outrider Dry Herb Thermal Extractor
item.g:description: Meet the first dry botanical thermal extractor from Rokin Aromatherapy Devices. The Rokin Outrider Thermal Extractor features a pocket-friendly & lightweight 5.5 oz design with a glass mouthpiece. The mouthpiece always stays cool and creates a glass airway for the most flavorful vapor rips. A simple-to-use interface is packed with powerful functionality and style, while a 1200mAh battery was built for continuous all-day use. The Outrider provides tasty & efficient vapor from your favorite dry herbs using a ceramic chamber and convection heating system to provide full flavors without harshness or combustion. The Outrider Thermal Extractor has an efficient heat-up time and haptic feedback to alert you when it is ready for use. Four calibrated heat settings designed for the optimal vaporization of dry herbs allow you to customize temperature control within seconds between 374°F, 392°F, 410°F, and 428°F. The Outrider uses single-button controls with a display to show your chosen temperature. Three clicks will turn the aromatherapy device on while holding the same button will change temperatures. If you're a flavor chaser, we recommend going for the lower temperatures, but if you like large clouds, turn up the heat. The Outrider has a color-coded indicator to show when you need a charge (red = 0-5%, green = 5-50%, blue = >50%), and the USB-C charging capability will have your thermal extractor up and running in no time. Key features: Rokin Outrider dry botanical Thermal Extractor; Optimized Temperature Settings; Isolated Glass Air Path; Fully Ceramic Oven. Category: Portable Vaporizer. Brand: Rokin Vapes.

item.g:title: Ooze Slim Twist Aromatherapy Device Pen Battery 2.0 + Smart USB - Panther Black
item.g:description: The Ooze Slim Twist 2.0 is here to steal the spotlight from its predecessor with new features that will improve your aromatherapy experience. The first and most important feature is its more efficient battery, resulting in a longer battery life. When you need a charge, you now have two options to get your Ooze Slim Twist up and running. The Smart USB is still included, but now there is a USB-C port with pass-through capability so you can continue to aromatherapy device while it is recharging. However, you’ll need to purchase and use your own cable, as it is not included in this kit. Ooze utilized customer feedback and lowered the voltage options from 2.0-4.0 volts. The new and improved Slim Twist also allows you to take a draw by auto-draw or pressing the button. The Slim Twist 2.0 is just as intuitive as the previous model. Simply press the button down to take a draw, and the battery will shut off automatically after 15 seconds of inhaling to protect against overheating. It has a preheat mode activated by clicking the power button twice. The battery will heat for 15 seconds in preheat mode without needing to hold the button down. The Ooze smart USB charger is included with each aromatherapy device pen and has built-in overcharge protection. The charger automatically shuts off as soon as the battery reaches a full charge, significantly extending each aromatherapy device pen's life. If you liked the Ooze Slim Twist, then you will love the upgraded Slim Twist 2.0! Key features: Ooze Slim Twist Battery 2.0 + Smart USB 🔋; Twist to Change Temps (2.0-4.0 volts); Designed for Pre-Filled sealed extract cartridge; Precision Temperature Control. Category: Vape Battery for Cartridges. Brand: Ooze.

The first and most important feature is its more efficient battery, resulting in a longer battery life. When you need a charge, you now have two options to get your Ooze Slim Twist up and running. The Smart USB is still included, but now there is a USB-C port with pass-through capability so you can continue to aromatherapy device while it is recharging. However, you’ll need to purchase and use your own cable, as it is not included in this kit. Ooze utilized customer feedback and lowered the voltage options from 2.0-4.0 volts. The new and improved Slim Twist also allows you to take a draw by auto-draw or pressing the button. The Slim Twist 2.0 is just as intuitive as the previous model. Simply press the button down to take a draw, and the battery will shut off automatically after 15 seconds of inhaling to protect against overheating. It has a preheat mode activated by clicking the power button twice. The battery will heat for 15 seconds in preheat mode without needing to hold the button down. The Ooze smart USB charger is included with each aromatherapy device pen and has built-in overcharge protection. The charger automatically shuts off as soon as the battery reaches a full charge, significantly extending each aromatherapy device pen's life. If you liked the Ooze Slim Twist, then you will love the upgraded Slim Twist 2.0! Key features: Ooze Slim Twist Battery 2.0 + Smart USB 🔋; Twist to Change Temps (2.0-4.0 volts); Designed for Pre-Filled sealed extract cartridge; Precision Temperature Control. Category: Vape Battery for Cartridges. Brand: Ooze.

item.g:title: Dr. Dabber XS E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus Thermal Extractor
item.g:description: Bigger isn’t always necessarily better when it comes to electric essential extract filtration systems. If you ever wished that your Dr. Dabber Switch Thermal Extractor was more portable for extracting on the go, your wish just came true. The XS E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus from Dr. Dabber shares many of the same premium features and technology as the Switch in a more travel-ready package. The engineers at Dr. Dabber thought of infinite ways to make the XS Thermal Extractor the best travel desktop filtration apparatus, including a new borosilicate glass hydrated micro-filtration device attachment with a splashguard that blocks water from reaching your mouth or spilling if the desktop filtration apparatus is tilted. The Dr. Dabber XS E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus also comes with a extract tool for loading your essential extracts and a carb cap with a leash, so your essential extract tools never get left behind. The Dr. Dabber XS E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus Thermal Extractor comes programmed with four different heat settings that enable you to unlock different flavor profiles from your essential extracts. Explore the full range of vapor profiles, from small, intensely flavorful draws to large-and-in-charge rips at the highest temperatures. The heating element of the XS E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus Thermal Extractor utilizes Dr. Dabber’s TCH technology which was developed to offer stable and accurate heating. In addition, the XS E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus features a newly designed quartz dish to evenly vaporize and extract the full flavors of your essential extracts. Key features: Dr. Dabber made certain the XS Thermal Extractor would always be ready for action. As a result, this portable e-desktop filtration apparatus can be heated to your desired temperature within 12 seconds. You can get up to 35 uses on a single charge which is more than sufficient for a long hike or day at the beach. While the XS battery is slightly smaller than the battery on the Switch, the unit is USB-C compatible, so it can be fully charged within 30-60 minutes. If you are using the XS E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus at home, you can continue using the thermal extractor while it is plugged in and charging. Don’t sacrifice quality for portability--get the XS E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus Thermal Extractor from one of the most reputable thermal extractor brands in the game!; Dr. Dabber XS E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus Thermal Extractor; Spill-Proof Glass hydrated micro-filtration device; Quartz Heating Dish. Category: Electric Rig / E-Nail. Brand: Dr. Dabber.

item.g:title: Pulsar Barb Fire H2O E-Nail Thermal Extractor Kit - Black
item.g:description: The Pulsar Barb Fire H2O eRig is the newest next-generation electronic essential extract filtration system from one of the most trusted names in the industry - Pulsar Thermal Extractors. Say goodbye to clunky, cumbersome e-nails that cost an arm and a leg. The Barb Fire H2O is the first portable eRig compact enough to keep up with your busy grab-and-go lifestyle without sacrificing flavor from your extracts. The glass water filtration attachment works to moisture-condition your vapor for smooth, comfortable inhales. With the Barb Fire H2O, you get the most out of your essential extracts with its Kanthal Coil, which can be heated to precise temps without flavor loss. Always at the forefront of essential oil vaporization technology, it comes as no surprise that Pulsar is leading the thermal extractor revolution. The Pulsar Barb Fire H2O features an ingenious design that employs a setup similar to a more traditional eRig with much more versatility. The Barb Fire H2O is powered by a 1450 mAh battery, so it holds its charge for many sessions without recharging. However, unlike a standard essential extract filtration system, the Barb Fire H2O is completely cordless. Simply fill the mouthpiece with water, load your favorite essential oil essential extract directly into the chamber, place the carb cap on top, press the button five times to turn it on, adjust to your preferred temperature setting, press the button again, and then inhale. Capable of 30-60 uses on a single battery charge, the Pulsar Barb Fire H2O eRig is changing the game one extract at a time. Key features: Pulsar Barb Fire H2O E-Nail Thermal Extractor; Water Filtration Mouthpiece; Wrapped Quartz Coil; Hand-Blown Glass. Category: Electric Rig / E-Nail. Brand: Pulsar.

item.g:title: Rokin Thunder 510-Threaded Battery - Black
item.g:description: Rokin Aromatherapy Devices answered the call for more power in your pocket with one of the only 380mAh 510-threaded aromatherapy device batteries on the market. Ultra-compact and discreet even with your pre-filled sealed extract cartridge screwed on, the Rokin Thunder 380mAh battery offers longer battery life for on-the-go use that keeps on going. Variable voltage lets you feel how you want with a few clicks of a button. Available in multiple sleek color schemes, the Rokin Thunder Aromatherapy Device Pen Battery looks just as great as it performs. The Rokin Thunder Aromatherapy Device Battery features single-button controls for easy operation. item.g:title: Puffco Proxy Thermal Extractor
item.g:description: It doesn’t take a detective to know this sherlock handheld piece is special. The Puffco Proxy is a highly versatile, portable, and customizable thermal extractor for essential oil essential extract consumption. This modular thermal extractor resembles a glass sherlock handheld piece and can be fully personalized with a number of compatible Puffco accessories and artistic third-party glass attachments that are continuing to be released. A glass botanical material receptacle can even be purchased to use this aromatherapy device with dry herbs! The Proxy can be broken down into two main components: the glass sherlock casing and the base that goes inside it. The included glass sherlock handheld piece is made from medical-grade glass that cools each draw and safely shelters the base. The base can be installed into a slew of other glass accessories, including Puffco’s Proxy hydrated micro-filtration device, and contains a state-of-the-art atomizer powered by Puffco’s 3D Chamber technology. The Proxy’s 3D Chamber is a futuristic innovation of thermal extractor heating technology. The ceramic material receptacle where you will load your materials is embedded with heating tracers that heat your essential extracts on the side walls as you inhale, instead of the bottom of the chamber, to preserve the quality of your oils. This highly advanced atomizer amplifies the flavors of your essential extracts and produces consistently smooth draws. The Proxy is equipped with four color-coded pre-set temperature settings that complement the flavor production of the 3D Chamber and offer different levels of vapor production. Use the Proxy on the blue setting (low heat) to enjoy the most flavor or green (medium heat) for a healthy balance of flavor and vapor production. The red setting (high heat) offers more vapor while still preserving flavor, and the white setting (Peak) provides the biggest extracts. Key features: The Puffco Proxy is an intuitive thermal extractor that is operated with single-button controls. Click the button to turn the Proxy on, select your desired heat setting, and double-click the button to begin heating. The Proxy takes approximately 30 seconds to fully heat and will flash and vibrate when ready. Hold the thermal extractor upright and inhale gently for maximum vapor production. The Puffco Proxy is the perfect travel companion when you’re on the go and includes a sturdy carrying case with extra storage for all-in-one portability. This thermal extractor features fast USB-C charging and can be fully charged in 90 minutes. Build your own custom masterpiece with the Puffco Proxy today!; The Puffco Proxy Essential Oil Thermal Extractor; 4 Pre-Set Temperature Settings; Borosilicate Glass Sherlock. Category: Portable Vaporizer. Brand: Puffco.

item.g:title: Wulf Mods Micro Plus Sealed Extract Cartridge Thermal Extractor - Black
item.g:description: The Wulf Mods Micro Plus is here to build on the solid foundation of the original Micro sealed extract cartridge Thermal Extractor. To vaporize your oils more effectively, the Micro Plus now comes with 4 variable voltage settings for more heat control than the 3 settings offered by the Micro. The Micro Plus Thermal Extractor also comes with two 510-threaded magnetic connectors, so switching your sealed extract cartridge is faster and easier than screwing your tank into the unit. Last but not least, the Micro Plus comes in fresh, eye-catching designs and colors to fit all preferences. The Micro Plus is Wulf Mods’ smallest and most portable thermal extractor at a mere 2” inches tall by 1” inch wide. This pocket-friendly thermal extractor battery is designed for waxy oil aromatherapy and features 510-threaded magnetic connectors for use with pre-filled essential extract or WELLNESS BLEND sealed extract cartridge. The open-face, open-top design of the Wulf Mods Micro Plus Thermal Extractor offers a clear view of your oil levels at all times and the battery fits nearly any 510-threaded sealed extract cartridge, solely dependent on width. Key features: As with nearly all of Wulf Mods’ products, quality is at the forefront. The Wolf Mods Micro Plus is made of durable materials and straightforward electronic components for an always reliable thermal extractor battery. The Micro Plus is equipped with 4 different voltage settings to accommodate nearly any aromatherapy style. Each heat setting is indicated by a color-coded light system and can be quickly adjusted using simple single-button controls. The small size of the Wulf Mods Micro Plus paired with the lowest voltage setting allows for stealthy use when out in public. You’ll basically be a ninja with this thing!; The Wolf Mods Micro Plus Thermal Extractor is so compact that it can easily fit within the palm of your hand. The 500mAh battery capacity is enough to last most users a full day of aromatherapy on the medium voltage setting. Choose between a variety of stylish colors and enjoy the most inconspicuous on-the-go pre-filled sealed extract cartridge battery to date with the Wolf Mods Micro Plus Thermal Extractor!; Wulf Mods Micro Plus sealed extract cartridge Thermal Extractor Fits Standard Pre-Filled sealed extract cartridge; 510-Thread Thermal Extractor Battery 🔋 4 Preset Heat Settings Pre-Heating Function Extremely Compact 500mAh Battery 2” inches Tall. Category: Portable Vaporizer. Brand: Wulf Mods.

item.g:title: Yocan UNI S - Fully Universal Sealed Extract Cartridge Thermal Extractor - Silver
item.g:description: The Yocan UNI S Box Mod Thermal Extractor has everything that made the original UNI one of the best sealed extract cartridge aromatherapy devices and features some major improvements. The UNI S, which is the successor to the original UNI, comes with a durable metallic body instead of a plastic body for superior durability. The Micro USB that the original UNI came with is no longer, as Yocan has upgraded this unit to USB-C for faster charging. The Yocan UNI S has been downsized and features a hanging hole for your lanyard or key ring, making it more travel-friendly than the original UNI. Adding an unprecedented higher level of customization to your aromatherapy session experience, the Yocan UNI S Aromatherapy Device features an adjustable sealed extract cartridge slot that works with any sized 510-threaded atomizer tank. The Yocan UNI S Box Mod Thermal Extractor eliminates the need for multiple aromatherapy device batteries for sealed extract cartridge with different-sized widths. Instead, the UNI S was engineered with an innovative slider on the outside of the battery that gives you full control over how far your sealed extract cartridge or atomizer sticks out and a dial that changes the diameter to fit different tank sizes. The UNI S is powered by a 400mAh battery that can be charged on the go with an included USB-C charger cable. Key features: To use the Yocan UNI S Aromatherapy Device Battery, simply attach the magnetic 510-threaded adapter to your pre-filled sealed extract cartridge or atomizers, adjust the height & width as needed, and insert your atomizer or sealed extract cartridge for a perfect fit every time. This Yocan Thermal Extractor offers complete temperature control with three variable voltages to give you full mastery over your flavors & cloud size. Fashioned with an advanced preheat function, the Yocan UNI S Thermal Extractor will warm up your essential extracts for 10 seconds to deliver smooth & flavorful rips whenever desired. Today, change how you use your pre-filled essential oil & WELLNESS BLEND sealed extract cartridge with the Yocan UNI S Box Mod Thermal Extractor!; 510-Threaded Aromatherapy Device Battery 🔋; The Yocan UNI S Box Mod Thermal Extractor; Made for Pre-Filled sealed extract cartridge & Tanks. item.g:title: Yocan UNI Pro 2.0 - Universal Sealed Extract Cartridge Thermal Extractor - Orange
item.g:description: The updated Yocan UNI Pro 2.0 Box Mod features a more durable metallic body and a USB-C port for faster charging. It also comes with the same total voltage and control layout that made the UNI Pro one of the best sealed extract cartridge thermal extractors on the market. Just like the original Yocan UNI Pro, the UNI Pro 2.0 adds an unprecedented level of customization to using your pre-filled sealed extract cartridge by utilizing an adjustable sealed extract cartridge slot that works with any size 510-threaded atomizer tank. Eliminating the need to own multiple aromatherapy device batteries for sealed extract cartridge with different sized widths & lengths, the UNI Pro 2.0 is equipped with an innovative slider on the outside of the battery that gives you full control over how far your sealed extract cartridge or atomizer sticks out, and a dial that changes the diameter to fit different tank widths. Simply attach the magnetic 510-threaded adapter to your pre-filled sealed extract cartridge or atomizers, adjust the height & width as needed, and insert your atomizer or sealed extract cartridge for a perfect fit every time. The Yocan UNI Pro 2.0 features a heavier body compared to its predecessor to give your sessions an elite feel, while the crisp OLED screen displays your voltage and temperature so you can easily adjust on-the-fly. Users who have strong preferences when it comes to their pre-filled oil & essential extract sealed extract cartridge will enjoy the UNI Pro 2.0 Thermal Extractor’s voltage control. Yocan is known for having preset temperatures in most of its thermal extractors but made a conscious effort to give experienced and more particular users options when using the UNI Pro 2.0. The voltage of the UNI Pro 2.0 can be adjusted in increments of.1 volts, with an overall range of 1.8-4.2v. If you’re a flavor chaser, you’ll be at home in the lower voltage range, while cloud enthusiasts will find the 3.5v-4.2v range very capable of producing thicker vapor. Key features: The design of the Yocan UNI Pro 2.0 makes changing temperatures super easy with distinct arrow buttons that indicate your chosen voltage on the bright OLED display. From the OLED screen, you’ll also be able to monitor the battery level as well as the preheating status. An upgraded 650mAh battery gives you a full day of casual aromatherapy sessions, and the compact size makes this one of the most portable box mods available. With intuitive controls and an easy-to-read display, the Yocan UNI Pro 2.0 Box Mod is great for both beginners and experienced aromatherapy device users alike to enjoy their favorite pre-filled essential oil, and WELLNESS BLEND sealed extract cartridge on the move.; The Yocan UNI 2.0 Box Mod Thermal Extractor 🔋 Made for Pre-Filled sealed extract cartridge & Tanks Fits any Size Oil Tank up to 14mm*; Precision Temperature Control Adjustable Atomizer Holder Height Adjustment Button Durable Metallic Body Bright OLED Display Oil Level Window 650mAh Battery Fully Universal Updated Design USB-C Charging Magnetic Connections 15 Second Auto Shut-Off 510-Thread Thermal Extractor Battery 10-Second Preheat Functionality; *Note: The Yocan UNI Pro 2.0 Thermal Extractor will fit any industry standard-sized 510-threaded atomizer or sealed extract cartridge up to an extra-wide 14mm.. item.g:description: If you’re looking for a sleek and stylish aromatherapy device pen battery that ’s compatible with all sorts of sealed extract cartridge, then the Ooze Slim Twist Thermal Extractor is the one for you! This classy thermal extractor pen is perfect for anyone who wants to enjoy their oils and extracts in fashion. The Ooze Slim Pen Twist Thermal Extractor features a 320mAh battery with a dial on the bottom that you can twist to select precision heat settings between 3.3-4.8 volts. Simply press the button down to take a draw, and the battery will shut off automatically after 15 seconds of inhaling to protect against overheating. The Ooze Slim Pen Twist Thermal Extractor has a p reheat mode activated by clicking the power button twice. The battery will heat for 15 seconds in preheat mode without needing to hold the button down. The Ooze smart USB charger is included with each aromatherapy device pen and has built-in overcharge protection. The charger automatically shuts off as soon as the battery reaches a full charge, which significantly extends the life of each aromatherapy device pen. With its powerful battery and smart USB charging capabilities, the Ooze Slim Pen Twist Battery is always ready to go when you are! Key features: Ooze Slim Pen Twist Battery + Smart USB 🔋; Twist to Change Temps ( 3.3-4.8 volts); Designed for Pre-Filled sealed extract cartridge; Precision Temperature Control. item.g:title: Grenco Science G Pen Elite II Thermal Extractor
item.g:description: The Elite II from Grenco Science is here to stand on the shoulders of its predecessor and hold its position as the most cutting-edge in dry botanical thermal extractor technology. With its dual-heater and air-path system, which allows it to access the full array of flavors, the Elite II has redefined the standards of herbal vaporization. The G Pen Elite II was designed to be the most compact, pocket-friendly, and ergonomic portable thermal extractor and features precise temperature control, a high-resolution TFT display, a battery level indicator, and an all-ceramic heating chamber. The high-tech G Pen Elite II is engineered with a patented clean air intake and convection and conduction dual heater technology that pumps out thick and flavorful vapor. The clean air intake on the Elite II doubles as a built-in carb and is molded directly into the durable zinc-alloy body. This allows the airflow to be controlled by your thumb with each rip. The unit is able to achieve vaporization temperatures quickly, without burning botanical, and maintain efficient temperature for long sessions. A long-lasting 2100mAh lithium-ion battery combined with USB-C fast-charging gives the device an hour of run time and can be fully recharged in 1.5 hours. These features give G Pen Elite II the edge over other portable thermal extractors allowing for the highest level of performance and dependability. Key features: The G Pen Elite II features precise temperature adjustment of temperatures between 200º - 430ºF (93º - 221ºC). Such range allows for a high level of experimentation and customization, allowing you to find your optimal temperature setting. With the new G Pen Elite II, you’re in total control of every aspect of your vaporization experience. The high-resolution TFT display illuminates the unit’s temperature to the exact degree. It will also display the exact temperature as the G Pen Elite II heats, so there’s no guess as to when it’s time to aromatherapy device. You can also see how much battery is left at a glance, making it clear when it’s time to charge.; The Elite II Mouthpiece is made of zirconia with an integrated spiral air-path, delivering cooled vapor and a comfortable contact temperature to the lips, and is magnetically attached for easy removal. At the opposite end, a handy built-in pick tool at the bottom of the device can assist in packing and clearing the oven. Get a dry botanical thermal extractor that is breaking boundaries and setting new standards of dry botanical thermal extractors with the G Pen Elite II from Grenco Science today!; G Pen Elite II dry botanical Thermal Extractor; TFT Screen Interface Display.
