item.g:title: Storz & Bickel Onyx Edition Volcano Thermal Extractor
item.g:description: The champion of desktop thermal extractors is back in black! The limited-edition Storz & Bickel Onyx Edition Volcano Thermal Extractor provides the same advanced features as the original Volcano Thermal Extractor, including precision temperature control, convection heating, and an easy-to-use balloon bag system. Representing German engineering at its finest, the Onyx Volcano Thermal Extractor by Storz & Bickel is the ultimate luxury desktop thermal extractor for dry botanical. The Onyx Volcano Thermal Extractor features the classic Storz & Bickel balloon bag filling system that allows you to take draws in a more portable manner from surgical-grade silicone balloon bags. One material receptacle of dry botanical will fill around 3 to 4 balloon bags of the Onyx Volcano. The new Easy Valve system is characterized by very easy handling and minimal maintenance work. Attaching a new balloon to the valve is no longer required, as the Easy Valve comes as a ready-to-use valve balloon unit including a mouthpiece that is already attached. Once the Easy Valve can no longer be used, you simply replace the old balloon bag with a new one. Eliminating the time-consuming task of cutting a bag to the correct size and attaching it to the solid valve, the Easy valve set for the Volcano Classic Thermal Extractor allows for rapid change of your thermal extractor bag anytime. The starter set included with the Storz & Bickel Onyx Edition Volcano Thermal Extractor is delivered with 5 Easy Valve balloons and the appropriate filling chamber. Key features: The Limited Edition Onyx Volcano Thermal Extractor utilizes a vacuum system that pumps in fresh, filtered air that is then heated to the ideal temperature for extracting the most compounds from your dry botanical. Convection heating is superior to conduction heating as it presents more flavors, aromas, and effects without causing combustion. The Onyx Volcano’s advanced diaphragm pump sends hot air flowing in to cover every millimeter of open surface area, ensuring that dry botanical is vaporized efficiently and thoroughly. Hot air passes over your aromatic blends or essential extracts to create vapor, filling your Volcano balloons for easy consumption.; The Onyx Edition Volcano’s refined design and industry-leading vapor production deliver a remarkable experience. A food-safe aluminum heating block and high-quality heating element deliver incredibly pure, potent vapor every session. The superior build quality ensures you’ll be enjoying the same level of vapor production for years to come. While most devices feature single or pre-set temperatures, the Onyx Volcano Thermal Extractor comes with precision temperature control. This allows you to pinpoint temperatures down to a single degree. You can zero in on the right temp for flavor, potency, smoothness, robustness, specific compounds, and more. Controlling temperature with the Onyx Volcano thermal extractor is easy, as you choose from a range of 266°F and 446°F using the classic analog dial on the front & center of the unit. Get your hands on the Storz & Bickel Onyx Edition Volcano Thermal Extractor today and enjoy a limited edition matte black desktop unit that goes unmatched in style and functionality.; S&B Onyx Edition Volcano Thermal Extractor; Limited Edition Onyx Color Drop. Category: Desktop Vaporizer. Brand: Storz & Bickel.

item.g:title: Storz & Bickel Onyx Edition Volcano Hybrid Thermal Extractor
item.g:description: Black is the new silver with this classy limited-edition makeover from Storz & Bickel. From the makers of the world-renowned Volcano Desktop Thermal Extractor comes the Onyx Edition Volcano Hybrid, the latest and greatest innovation from Storz & Bickel. Compared to the legendary Volcano Digital Thermal Extractor, the Hybrid Onyx Edition boasts a heat-up time that is 10 times faster, an improved airflow system, and a newly designed smartphone app that offers total mastery over your vapor production. Convection heating is paired with precision temperature control to provide a wide array of flavor profiles, while a long-awaited dual-inhalation system now allows you to choose between the classic balloon bag delivery method or convert your new Onyx Edition Volcano Hybrid into a whip-style thermal extractor! The innovative dual-inhalation system on the Volcano Hybrid Onyx Edition features options for both whip-style inhalation and classic Storz & Bickel reusable balloon bags. Simply fill the included balloon bags with the built-in air pump, or enjoy silent draws directly from the heating chamber using the included whip. Volcano Thermal Extractors are known for their exceptional flavor production and the new whip-style system delivers resistance-free, quiet draws that are even tastier because you pull vapor directly from the heating chamber as opposed to the balloon bag. The whip kit included with the Onyx Hybrid Thermal Extractor was engineered for sharing, designed to eliminate any tangled tubing when passing around. It also has an ergonomic mouthpiece that provides a comfortable, airtight seal for every draw. Key features: The Limited Edition Onyx Volcano Hybrid Thermal Extractor is equipped with Storz & Bickel’s iconic convection heating system. Instead of heating your materials directly on the hot surface of the loading chamber, the elite heating system propels air through the vapor path using a 100-watt heater. This method extracts optimal flavors from your dry herbs with essentially zero risk of combustion. The Volcano Hybrid Onyx Edition always provides smooth vapor that’s easy on the lungs, free of unwanted tastes or odors. Just like its predecessor, this premium desktop unit features a dual-compatible design that will work with both dry herbs and essential oil essential extracts. If you wish to aromatherapy device essential extracts instead, simply insert a liquid drip pad (not included) into the filling chamber and you're good to go! (The Onyx Hybrid Thermal Extractor features its own distinct set of accessories and does not work with the Volcano Liquid Pads that were universal in Storz & Bickel products of the past).; The Storz & Bickel Onyx Edition Volcano Hybrid Thermal Extractor was fashioned with easy-to-use, integrated touch buttons that help you masterfully execute your aromatherapy device sessions. A bright LED screen displays both your chosen heat setting and the exact temperature of your unit, while simple “+” and “-” buttons allow you to hone in on your ideal temperatures. Storz & Bickel equipped the Onyx Volcano Hybrid with an expansive temperature range between 104°F and 446°F to offer a full flavor spectrum of heat settings and meet any personal preference. A newly engineered smartphone app now allows you to easily manage and control your Onyx Edition Hybrid Thermal Extractor directly from your smartphone via Bluetooth compatibility. The app provides you with full control over each session and advanced details about your new desktop unit. Complete with a full suite of compatible Storz & Bickel parts & accessories, the Onyx Volcano Hybrid Thermal Extractor has everything you need for a truly enjoyable aromatherapy experience. The Volcano Hybrid Onyx Edition sports a sleek matte black design with impressive features and groundbreaking upgrades that are guaranteed to provide you with the same outstanding vapor quality you’ve come to know and love from Storz & Bickel.; Volcano Hybrid Onyx Edition Thermal Extractor; Whip-Style & Balloon Bag Delivery. Category: Desktop Vaporizer. Brand: Storz & Bickel.

item.g:title: Storz & Bickel Mighty+ Thermal Extractor
item.g:description: If you thought the renowned Mighty Thermal Extractor couldn’t get any better, Storz & Bickel has a surprise in store with the new and improved Mighty+ Thermal Extractor. Taking the original Mighty back to the drawing board, this redesigned portable thermal extractor delivers faster charging with its new USB-C Supercharge capabilities that can charge your unit up to 80% in just 40 minutes. In addition to a rapid charge, the USB-C modification allows you to charge on the go by using any portable battery as an extension, rather than requiring a wall outlet like its predecessor. The Storz & Bickel Mighty+ also features an updated circuit board that can reach your desired temperature within 60 seconds of turning on the thermal extractor. The Storz & Bickel Mighty+ Thermal Extractor has adopted the Super-Boost mode from its little sibling, the Crafty+, which increases the temperature and produces thick vapor clouds with just three clicks. The Mighty+ comes with a new and improved ceramic-coated filling chamber, making it even more sturdy and resistant than the original Mighty chamber. Storz & Bickel engineered the Mighty+ Thermal Extractor with a hybrid heating system that combines conduction and convection heating methods. This patented technology is proven to excel in evenly heating your materials inside the chamber and enables the Mighty+ to quickly reach your desired temperatures with little to no risk of combustion. The powerful heating system also provides exceptional airflow and minimal draw resistance that allows you to breathe in effortlessly from the swivel mouthpiece. The Mighty+ Thermal Extractor is equipped with an ingenious cooling unit made from PEEK, a high-grade heat-resistant plastic that works to extend the vapor path and give each draw maximum time to cool down. Key features: If you ever had issues standing up your Mighty between uses, the Mighty+ Thermal Extractor features discrete fins on the bottom of the device to make it stand more securely on flat surfaces. The same tactical design used on the original Mighty can be seen on the new Mighty+ Aromatherapy Device, with a ribbed exterior that resembles a radiator. This unique design not only provides an exceptional grip but allows heat to dissipate from the grooves, that way the device never overheats in your hands during back-to-back draws. This streamlined design plus the ability to charge anywhere makes the Storz & Bickel Mighty+ Thermal Extractor the ultimate travel companion for all of life’s adventures.; The improved circuit board and USB-C Supercharge capability of the Mighty+ Thermal Extractor were designed to provide more back-to-back sessions with less time spent charging your device. Compared to its predecessor, the Mighty+ boasts a much faster heat-up time that is ready for action in as little as 60 seconds. The brand new Super Boost mode can be activated with a triple-click of the power button and provides extra thick vapor clouds from your chosen materials by raising the temperatures 15°C, or 27°F. Spend more time aromatherapy and less time waiting with the Mighty+ Thermal Extractor from Storz & Bickel today!; How to Use:; Using the Mighty+ Thermal Extractor is simple and easy. The orange circular button located on the side of the device allows you to turn the device on/off. Due to the plus-/minus keys and the easily visible LED display, the operation of the Mighty is self-explanatory. The device is ready for use as soon as the actual temperature corresponds to the individually adjustable set temperature. The personally preferred temperature can be adjusted gradually during vaporization through the setting options directly on the device.. Category: Portable Vaporizer. Brand: Storz & Bickel.

item.g:title: Lemonnade x G Pen Micro+ Thermal Extractor
item.g:description: A stunning collaboration between G Pen and legendary Bay Area rapper Berner, the Lemonnade x G Pen Micro+ Thermal Extractor is as cool as a tall glass of lemonade on a hot summer day! This fully customized G Pen Micro+ Thermal Extractor is decked out from top to bottom in universally recognized Lemonnade yellow with a matching yellow hemp travel case included. This limited-edition release is both visually stunning and revolutionary in functionality, just like the original Micro+ Thermal Extractor. The Lemonnade G Pen Micro+ is the pinnacle of essential oil thermal extractor pens. This discreet essential extract pen features supreme functionality and an intuitive design made for on-the-go aromatherapy. The Micro Plus replaces Grenco Science’s Micro G Thermal Extractor, outfitted with countless upgrades to match more modern and effective aromatherapy device pens. The Lemonnade Edition Micro+ is equipped with unique smart-chip technology that regulates consistent heat distribution to ensure that each extract is evenly vaporized, meaning more flavor and less wasted materials. Battery life was an issue with the original Micro G, and the Lemonnade Micro+ Thermal Extractor Pen features a more powerful, longer-lasting 850mAh lithium-ion battery with haptic feedback and USB-C charging. Key features: The Lemonnade x G Pen Micro+ Thermal Extractor features sealed extract cartridge Recognition Technology that allows you to switch between the Micro+ Tank or any other industry standard 510-thread pre-filled sealed extract cartridge. This proprietary technology unique to G Pen recognizes when you swap your atomizer with a pre-filled sealed extract cartridge and adjusts the Micro+ battery to apply separate power outputs for optimal heating. The Lemonnade Micro+ tank combines a fully ceramic heating plate with a quartz liner inside a stainless steel enclosure. The dual-channel stainless steel housing features integrated airflow that is built to provide consistent heat application. The result is optimized flavor profiles on every heat setting and balanced airflow for maximum vapor production.; The final component of the Lemonnade G Pen Micro+ Thermal Extractor is the food-grade silicone mouthpiece. The mouthpiece has an ergonomic design intended to rest comfortably on your lips with each pull. The ceramic air path inside the mouthpiece ensures steady airflow and offers hassle-free cleaning. Grenco Science bundled the Lemonnade Edition Micro+ Thermal Extractor with a matching hemp travel case that includes designated space for a essential oil container, a mesh pocket with a branded G Pen Keychain Tool, and a USB to USB-C Charging Cable. Try out the latest and greatest in aromatherapy device pen technology and do it in style with the Lemonnade G Pen Micro+ Thermal Extractor!; How to Use:; Using the Lemonnade G Pen Micro+ Thermal Extractor is very straightforward with its simple single-button controls. To turn the device on/off, rapidly click the power button 5 times. The LED light around the button will blink 3 times to let you know the device is fully powered. Click the button 3 times to toggle through the 3 voltage settings that are color-coded to represent each temperature. Blue signifies low heat (2.5V), green is medium (2.75V), and red represents high heat (3.0V).. Category: Vaporizer Pen. Brand: Grenco Science.

item.g:title: Lookah Unicorn Electric Essential Extract Filtration System - Neon Green
item.g:description: The Unicorn E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus from Lookah always puts on a show with its sleek design, high performance, and flavorful rips. This one-of-a-kind electronic essential extract filtration system features a cone-shaped quick-connect percolator with twin vapor airways that effectively filter and cool your draws. You can count on the Unicorn to extract the most flavor from your essential extracts with two different styles of quartz atomizers. The powerful 1900mAh battery heats up the coils in seconds and provides many extract sessions on a single charge. This E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus comes with three preset temperatures, so it is compatible with all types of essential extracts and allows you to customize your experience with more flavorful draws on the lowest setting or big clouds on the highest. The LED light ring around the power button and haptic feedback are effective for alerting the user about battery and heating. When it is time to charge, the Unicorn has a USB charger, making it ultra-convenient to charge and use on the go. Another feature that makes this device travel friendly is the silicone plug that keeps water from leaking out of the glass hydrated micro-filtration device attachment when on the go. Finding a thermal extractor with so many premium features packed into one device is rare, so don’t miss out on the Unicorn E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus from Lookah! Key features: Lookah Unicorn Electric Essential Extract Filtration System; 3 Preset Temperature Settings; Single Button Design; 1900 mAh Battery. Category: Electric Rig / E-Nail. Brand: Lookah.

item.g:title: Wulf Yocan UNI Pro Universal Sealed Extract Cartridge Thermal Extractor - Teal & Black
item.g:description: If you love the Yocan UNI Pro, you’re going to go wild for the Wulf UNI Pro sealed extract cartridge Thermal Extractor! Made by Wulf Mods and powered by Yocan, this powerhouse aromatherapy device battery adds an unprecedented level of customization to using your pre-filled sealed extract cartridge with an adjustable sealed extract cartridge slot that works with any size 510-threaded oil tank. Effectively eliminating the need to own multiple aromatherapy device batteries for sealed extract cartridge with different sized widths & lengths, the Wulf UNI Pro is equipped with an innovative slider on the outside of the battery that gives you full control over how far your sealed extract cartridge sticks out, and a dial that changes the diameter to fit different tank widths. Simply attach the magnetic 510-threaded adapter to your pre-filled sealed extract cartridge or atomizer, adjust the height & width as needed, and insert your atomizer or sealed extract cartridge for a perfect fit every time! The Wulf UNI Pro Adjustable sealed extract cartridge Thermal Extractor employs an adjustable voltage-based output, 10-second preheating function, and a universal 510 threaded connection, all in a durable zinc alloy body. The crisp OLED screen displays your voltage and temperature settings so you can easily adjust on-the-fly while the unique color combinations add unrivaled style to every draw. From the OLED screen, you’ll also be able to monitor the battery level and the preheating status. An upgraded 650mAh battery gives you a full day of casual aromatherapy sessions, and the compact size of the Wulf UNI Pro makes this one of the most portable box mods available. Key features: Users who have strong preferences for their pre-filled oil and essential extract sealed extract cartridge will enjoy the Wulf UNI Pro Thermal Extractor’s voltage control. Yocan is known for having preset temperatures in most of their thermal extractors but made a conscious effort to give experienced and more particular users options when using the Wulf UNI Pro. The voltage of the Wulf UNI Pro can be adjusted in increments of.1 volts, with an overall range of 2.0-4.2v. If you’re a flavor chaser, you’ll be at home in the lower voltage range, while cloud enthusiasts will find the 3.5v-4.2v range capable of producing thicker vapor. Snag the Wulf UNI Pro Adjustable sealed extract cartridge Thermal Extractor today and enjoy unrivaled style paired with intuitive controls that make this the best aromatherapy device battery for pre-filled sealed extract cartridge!; Wulf Yocan UNI Pro sealed extract cartridge Thermal Extractor 🔋; Made for Pre-Filled sealed extract cartridge & Tanks; Fits any Size Oil Tank up to 12mm*. Category: Vape Battery for Cartridges. Brand: Wulf Mods.

item.g:title: Lemonnade x G Pen Roam Thermal Extractor
item.g:description: A stunning collaboration between G Pen and legendary Bay Area rapper Berner, the Lemonnade x G Pen Roam Thermal Extractor is as cool as a tall glass of lemonade on a hot summer day! This fully customized G Pen Roam Thermal Extractor is decked out from top to bottom in universally recognized Lemonnade yellow with a matching yellow hemp travel case included. This limited-edition release is both visually stunning and revolutionary in functionality, just like the original Roam Thermal Extractor. The Lemonnade G Pen Roam delivers water filtration in a portable essential extract thermal extractor that is built to last. An ergonomic design makes carrying the Roam Thermal Extractor easy, and the device houses a glass hydro-tube that purifies and cools your vapor each draw. The G Pen Roam's quartz tank does a fantastic job saving your material’s flavor, even with the high-temperature range of 600°F to 800°F. Powered by a 1300mAh lithium-ion battery, the Lemonnade G Pen Roam charges quickly, can be used during the charging process, and stays alive for an entire day of aromatherapy. Key features: The Lemonnade G Pen Roam features a full quartz tank with a protective silicone housing that works to bring out your essential extracts' full flavors. Compared to titanium tanks or heating elements, quartz does a much better job of letting you taste your draws and has a much faster heat-up time. The Roam Thermal Extractor gets to temperature quickly due to the quartz tank working in conjunction with the powerful 1300mAh battery. Even with such a high-temperature range, the Lemonnade G Pen Roam will let you taste your material during sessions, delivering a mix of dense clouds and flavorful vapor.; Inside of the Lemonnade Roam’s housing is the glass hydro-tube water filtration system. The hydro-tube serves as the “vapor path” for the Roam and is attached directly to the mouthpiece. In keeping the hydro-tube so close to the mouthpiece, Grenco Science ensured that you’d get fresh draws with each pull since your vapor is going directly from the chamber to your lips, with no unnecessary space in between. Each Lemonnade G Pen Roam complete kit arrives inside a Lemonnade yellow hemp travel case with room for two essential extracts jars and a pocket for accessories. This pocket is perfect for traveling with the included micro-USB-to-USB charging cable, loading tool, and cleaning swabs.; Lemonnade x G Pen Roam Thermal Extractor; 600°F-800°F Heating Range. Category: Portable Vaporizer. Brand: Grenco Science.

item.g:title: Yocan UNI Twist - Fully Universal Sealed Extract Cartridge Thermal Extractor - Black
item.g:description: Come on, let’s twist again, Twistin’ time is here! The Yocan UNI Twist Box Mod Thermal Extractor has everything that made the original UNI one of the best sealed extract cartridge aromatherapy devices and features some major improvements. The UNI Twist, which is a spin-off of the original UNI, comes in a thinner and more pocket-friendly design without making any sacrifices. In addition to slimming down the body of the Twist, it features a hanging hole for your lanyard or key ring, making it even more travel friendly than the UNI. The Twist was also upgraded to a durable metallic body instead of a plastic body for superior durability. In order to speed up charge times, the Twist comes with a USB-C rather than a Micro USB charger of the original UNI. The main feature that makes the Yocan UNI Twist special is the variable voltage dial on the bottom of the unit, which allows users to change temps with the twist of their wrist. Adding an unprecedented higher level of customization to your aromatherapy session experience, the Yocan UNI Twist Aromatherapy Device features an adjustable sealed extract cartridge slot that works with any sized 510-threaded atomizer tank. The Yocan UNI Twist Box Mod Thermal Extractor eliminates the need for multiple aromatherapy device batteries for sealed extract cartridge with different-sized widths. Instead, the UNI Twist was engineered with an innovative slider on the outside of the battery that gives you full control over how far your sealed extract cartridge or atomizer sticks out and a dial that changes the diameter to fit different tank sizes. The UNI Twist is powered by a 650mAh battery that can be charged on the go with an included USB-C charger cable. Key features: To use the Yocan UNI Twist Aromatherapy Device Battery, simply attach the magnetic 510-threaded adapter to your pre-filled sealed extract cartridge or atomizers, adjust the height & width as needed, and insert your atomizer or sealed extract cartridge for a perfect fit every time. This Yocan Thermal Extractor offers complete temperature control with a variable voltage dial that ranges from 1.8-4.2v to give you full mastery over your flavors & cloud size. Fashioned with an advanced preheat function, the Yocan UNI Twist Thermal Extractor will warm up your essential extracts for 10 seconds to deliver smooth & flavorful rips whenever desired. Change the way you use your pre-filled essential oil & WELLNESS BLEND sealed extract cartridge with the Yocan UNI Twist Box Mod Thermal Extractor today!; 510-Threaded Aromatherapy Device Battery 🔋; The Yocan UNI Twist Mod Thermal Extractor; Made for Pre-Filled sealed extract cartridge & Tanks. Category: Vape Battery for Cartridges. Brand: Yocan.

item.g:title: X-Max Qomo Micro E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus - Black
item.g:description: The X-Max Qomo Micro E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus was designed to give you large filtered draws in a small portable package. The Qomo boasts incredible features starting with its strong and long-lasting 1350 mAh battery that pre-heats this electric essential extract filtration system in as little as ten seconds. Standing a compact 5” inches tall, this little e-desktop filtration apparatus packs a large punch and produces thick, flavorful clouds through its ceramic bucket atomizer. The Qomo comes with a removable glass hydrated micro-filtration device mouthpiece that provides water filtration for smoother extracts and can be easily filled, attached, and cleaned when needed. To fill it up, we recommend using a slight trickle from your sink’s tap to fill with water up to the red fill line, which will ensure you don't get any splashback while in use. The X-Max Qomo Micro E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus has three temperature settings with colored LED lights to indicate your device's selected temperature (White:536°F/ Green:608°F/ Red:662°F). Once you have added your essential extracts inside the ceramic bucket, placed the carb cap on the vapor dome, and turned the device on with 3 clicks of the power button, the temperature level light will begin to glow. If you would like to change your heat setting, click the power button twice to toggle to your desired temperature. The power light will pulse a few times while the thermal extractor is heating up, then change to a solid color to signal that it’s ready to rip. Key features: The X-Max Qomo Micro E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus produces optimal results when packing smaller loads of your essential extract and inhaling using a slow, sipping style technique. X-Max also recommends cleaning the ceramic atomizer with a q-tip between sessions to provide the purest and most flavorful draws. You can keep the rest of your device clean simply by using isopropyl alcohol on the glass hydrated micro-filtration device and vapor dome to remove any residue that builds up with continued use. The USB-C charging capability will bring your thermal extractor to full charge in under two hours, and the charge can last up to 2 days with moderate use. X-Max proudly stands by its product and offers a 6-month manufacturer's warranty on the Qomo device and a 30-day warranty on the atomizer. Get the X-Max Qomo Micro E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus today for an affordable, easy-to-use, and portable electric essential extract filtration system that will never disappoint!; X-Max Qomo Micro E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus Thermal Extractor; Multi-Color LED Lighting System; 1-2 Day Average Battery Life. item.g:title: KandyPens Session 2-in-1 E-Nail Thermal Extractor - Black
item.g:description: The engineers at KandyPens were tasked with designing the most powerful e-nail thermal extractor on the market, and they did not disappoint. The KandyPens Session E-Nail is KandyPens’ premiere next-gen dual-function thermal extractor and has the ability to be used by itself as a handheld thermal extractor or paired with your favorite hydro-vessel for use as an electric extract nail. Equipped with a powerful 1200mAh battery, the KandyPens Session E-nail creates lung-expanding extracts without adulterating the essential tastes and flavors of your essential oil essential extracts. The Variable Voltage Battery has 4 heat settings (2.6V, 3.0V, 3.6V, 4.2V), so you can choose the temperature sweet-spot for large yet comfortable vapor clouds that work best for you. The KandyPens Session Thermal Extractor enables extracting on-the-go without the hassle of needing a high-output ignition source. The fully ceramic heating chamber combined with the variable voltage battery provides robust, flavorful extracts with more accuracy than a glass desktop filtration apparatus and high-output ignition source. The Session includes a 14mm male glass adapter that allows you to connect this e-nail to any hydro-vessel or oil desktop filtration apparatus with a 14mm female pre-rolled inhalation unit. Don’t have your hydro-vessel with you? No problem. Remove the glass hydro-vessel adapter and attach the included magnetic glass mouthpiece, and the session becomes a portable essential oil thermal extractor that fits in the palm of your hand. The Aluminum Alloy Shell is available in three tasteful classic colors and ensures your thermal extractor stays safe while on the move. Key features: The KandyPens Session E-Nail Thermal Extractor measures an ultra-compact 2.5” inches tall despite its beefed-up battery that provides more than enough draws without having to charge throughout the day. When you do need to charge the Session, the USB-C fast charging feature makes it super quick and convenient to charge from anywhere. If you happen to forget to power down your Session, the 5-minute auto-shutoff feature always has you covered. Get thick and satisfying extracts everywhere & anywhere with the KandyPens Session E-nail Thermal Extractor today!; KandyPens Session E-Nail Thermal Extractor; Powerful 1200mAh Battery; Ceramic Heating Chamber. Category: Electric Rig / E-Nail. Brand: KandyPens.

item.g:title: Yocan High-Output Ignition Source 2020 E-Nail - Sakura Pink
item.g:description: The Yocan high-output ignition source 2020 is a revamped and refreshed version of an old favorite, the Yocan high-output ignition source eNail. This updated version received more than just a face-lift and is equipped with the best features a portable electric extract nail has to offer. The Yocan high-output ignition source 2020 E-Nail has the same unique shape as its predecessor while sporting a wide array of new colors for you to choose from. Just like before, the new design offers compatibility with a wider range of glass hydrated micro-filtration device, oil desktop filtration apparatuses, and hydro-vessels thanks to the built-in fully universal attachment. Youâ€™ll also find a metal tube and a glass tube that the older version also offered (weâ€™ll dive into the uses below). The new features include the addition of Yocanâ€™s latest heating element, the quartz tri coil seen with the Yocan Regen Thermal Extractor, and the quartz dual coil atomizers used in the Yocan Evolve Plus. These beefed-up heating elements allow you to take full advantage of moisture-conditioned vapor while extracting with the Yocan high-output ignition source 2020 E-Nail. The Yocan high-output ignition source 2020 E-Nail is compatible with a wide range of hydro-filtration devices, hydro-vessels, oil desktop filtration apparatuses, and other glass used in consuming essential oil essential extracts. The adapter on the bottom is a removable universal adapter with three levels and can be used to connect to any 14mm or 18mm glass pre-rolled inhalation unit. Use it as pictured above to connect to any female pre-rolled inhalation unit hydro-vessel, or turn the adapter upside-down and use it with male pre-rolled inhalation unit attachments! The Yocan high-output ignition source Adapter provides a great fit to glassware of all sizes and the airtight design prevents outside air from leaking through the pre-rolled inhalation unit for superior vapor production. Key features: As mentioned above, the Yocan high-output ignition source 2020 delivers superior quality vapor by using the brand'sÂ iconic heating elements that have practically made a name for themselves. This portable electric extract nail comes with two premium atomizers, each 510-threaded so they can easily be removed and replaced, even by beginners. The quartz dual coil atomizer allows for smooth and effective vaporization of your select essential oil essential extracts, better suited for those who like more flavor and a subtle body buzz. The quartz tri coils offer even faster vapor production and highly potent rips, taking the Yocan high-output ignition source 2020 E-Nail to a whole new level.; The Yocan high-output ignition source 2020 E-Nail offers impeccable airflow control through the use of the metal tube attached to the top of the heating element. Although it may seem insignificant, airflow greatly contributes to the production and quality of your vapor. The less air you let in, the warmer the vapor production is; but it also means that you get more flavorful and potent rips as youâ€™re basically inhaling extracted vapor from your essential oil essential extracts in its purest form. On the other hand, allowing more air into the atomizer increases the vapor density and lets the vapor cool down as the colder outside air mixes with the warm vapors produced by the heating element. Using the inclusive metal tube, you can adjust the airflow of the Yocan high-output ignition source 2020 E-Nail allowing you to customize and personalize your sessions. An airflow button located at the top of the metal tube can be pressed down to let in air and will block the air when released. Simple, straightforward, yet highly effective.; To improve flavor retention, the Yocan high-output ignition source 2020 also includes a glass tube to cap the atomizer. Unlike other materials, glass is inert meaning it does not have any immediate chemical reaction to heat. This keeps the vapor pure and clean while promoting optimal flavors from your essential extracts compared to cheaper materials like weak metal or plastic. Because glass does not rub off on the vapors even when exposed to extreme heat, it will never leave a bad taste or unwanted smell in your extract sessions. For both connoisseurs and medical botanical blend users, the ability to inhale vapors that are clean and are true to taste is important. Itâ€™s no longer just the flavor but the overall quality of the vapor that is preserved by using the glass tube.Â; The Yocan high-output ignition source 2020 improves on the platform paved by its predecessor and allows for a better aromatherapy experience altogether. Itâ€™s a revolutionary device thatâ€™s proved to be way ahead of its time as many thermal extractor manufacturers have started making similar devices. Extract with the original portable electric extract nail today with the Yocan high-output ignition source 2020 E-Nail!. Category: Electric Rig / E-Nail. Brand: Yocan.

item.g:title: Yocan DRAW Dry Herb Thermal Extractor - Sky Blue
item.g:description: The Yocan DRAW Thermal Extractor is the newest dry botanical thermal extractor from Yocan and the brand’s first real entry to the portable dry botanical thermal extractor scene! The Yocan DRAW Thermal Extractor is outfitted with smart features like a crisp OLED display that feeds you with all the necessary information you’ll need when aromatherapy. You’ll also get an intelligent notification function that vibrates to alert you with what’s happening with your dry botanical thermal extractor. This haptic feedback technology is ultra-convenient while you’re on-the-go and don't have time to look at the screen. The Yocan DRAW Thermal Extractor will simply vibrate once and you’ll know that it’s either powering on or powering off. The device will vibrate twice to let you know that it has reached its targeted temperature level so you won’t have to keep on looking at the screen! The DRAW is also equipped with a convection oven that’s designed and engineered to expertly vaporize your dry botanical strains with superior airflow. Yocan effectively improved the art of convection heating by using a ceramic-based oven to heat the herbs inside the chamber rather than heating the walls of the chamber like convection-based aromatherapy devices of the past. This allows your dry herbs to be vaporized without reaching the point of combustion, thereby providing clean and smooth vapor every draw. The addition of an integrated stir tool lets you conveniently mix your herbs as you see fit so they won’t char or get burned when in the chamber! Key features: The Yocan DRAW Thermal Extractor stands a discreet 4.5” inches tall and fits perfectly in the palm of your hands. The compact size is also proportionate to its weight, making the DRAW a well-balanced device that’s not too heavy yet not too flimsy. Sporting a powerful 1400mAh battery, the Yocan DRAW Thermal Extractor has enough power to push through your regular rituals without having to sacrifice performance. While many portable devices still use micro USB technology, the Yocan DRAW Thermal Extractor ensures that you have the latest and fastest in data and power transfer with its USB-C charging capabilities. Because it’s equipped with a USB-C charging cable, its recharge time is significantly faster and the delivery of power is more stable.; The Yocan DRAW Thermal Extractor offers a dual aromatherapy mode that allows it to run in different time frames to better personalize and customize your sessions. One heating mode runs a cycle for three minutes while the other one runs a cycle for five minutes. Each heating mode creates a distinct effect that allows the Yocan DRAW Thermal Extractor to yield a more pronounced effect. If you want a portable dry botanical thermal extractor that can keep up with your demands, offer you premium features, and still be an affordable option, make sure to check out the Yocan DRAW Thermal Extractor today!; Yocan DRAW Thermal Extractor; Convection Oven. Category: Vaporizer Pen. Brand: Yocan.

item.g:title: XVape Vista Mini 2 Portable E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus - Silver
item.g:description: The XVape Vista Mini 2 is a reimagining and vast cutting-edge update in the world of compact yet powerful thermal extractors for essential oil essential extracts & oils. The Vista Mini 2 includes a one-of-a-kind glass discovery carb cap perfect for viability, an ergo-blaze flared mouthpiece tooled for comfort, detachable glass hydrated micro-filtration device, secure flow silicone seal, a revolutionary AIO crystal quartz atomizer equipped with short circuit protection, along with all your favorite features from the first version like wireless charging and vibrating haptic feedback. This brand new electric essential extract filtration system is a statement piece and the perfect size for your desk, coffee table, or taking with you on-the-go. As an added bonus, the Vista Mini 2 comes with an impact-resistant & smell-proof carrying case that secures your unit and fits all your necessities for extracting! The XVape Vista Mini 2 E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus Thermal Extractor excels in offering exceptional tastes and accentuated flavors. This stunning device features 4 heat settings perfectly optimized for essential extracts of all varieties, managed conveniently by a multi-color LED lighting system that changes with your temperature. With its solidly built, compact & lightweight design, this essential extract thermal extractor offers the features of a larger desktop unit wrapped up in a smaller, more exquisite package. The thick glass central core of the Vista Mini 2 operates as a hydrated micro-filtration device by using a small amount of water to smooth out your vapor and optimize the quality of each draw. If taste is important to you, then the Vista Mini 2 E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus will be a dream come true. Key features: With an eye always in the future of both design and fashion, XVape has taken the technology and the design of the Vista Mini 2 to another level. We’ve all run into the problem of not being able to find a charging wire for our thermal extractor when we need one. Well, the engineers at the XVape solved this problem with one of the coolest features around—wireless charging. All it takes is a wireless charging pad or power-sharing on your mobile device, and your XVape Vista Mini 2 E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus can be back up and running without the hassle of wires or cables! (Don't worry, your standard run-of-the-mill USB charger is still included).; A burned out or poorly-performing atomizer can also plague your extracting experience. XVape has once again outdone the competition by developing an atomizer that can be removed & replaced in mere seconds with a few simple twists! Snag the XVape Vista Mini 2 Electric Essential Extract Filtration System today and enjoy better tasting vapor with an array of mind-boggling features found only in e-desktop filtration apparatuses & thermal extractors priced hundreds of dollars more.; XVape Vista Mini 2 E-Desktop Filtration Apparatus Thermal Extractor; Multi-Color LED Lighting System. Category: Electric Rig / E-Nail. Brand: Xvape.

item.g:title: Yocan UNI Pro - Universal Sealed Extract Cartridge Thermal Extractor - Dark Blue
item.g:description: The updated Yocan UNI Pro Box Mod features a more powerful battery, total voltage control, and has a new control layout to streamline your aromatherapy sessions. Just like the original Yocan UNI, the UNI Pro adds an unprecedented level of customization to using your pre-filled sealed extract cartridge by utilizing an adjustable sealed extract cartridge slot that works with any size 510-threaded atomizer tank. Eliminating the need to own multiple aromatherapy device batteries for sealed extract cartridge with different sized widths & lengths, the UNI Pro is equipped with an innovative slider on the outside of the battery that gives you full control over how far your sealed extract cartridge or atomizer sticks out, and a dial that changes the diameter to fit different tank widths. Simply attach the magnetic 510-threaded adapter to your pre-filled sealed extract cartridge or atomizers, adjust the height & width as needed, and insert your atomizer or sealed extract cartridge for a perfect fit every time. The Yocan UNI Pro features a sleeker and sharper look compared to its predecessor to give your sessions an elite feel, while the crisp OLED screen displays your voltage and temperature so you can easily adjust on-the-fly. Users who have strong preferences when it comes to their pre-filled oil & essential extract sealed extract cartridge will enjoy the UNI Pro Thermal Extractor’s voltage control. Yocan is known for having preset temperatures in most of their thermal extractors but made a conscious effort to give experienced and more particular users options when using the UNI Pro. The voltage of the UNI Pro can be adjusted in increments of.1 volts, with an overall range of 2.0-4.2v. If you’re a flavor chaser, you’ll be at home in the lower voltage range, while cloud enthusiasts will find the 3.5v-4.2v range very capable of producing thicker vapor. Key features: The new design of the Yocan UNI Pro makes changing temperatures super easy with distinct arrow buttons that indicate your chosen voltage on the bright OLED display. From the OLED screen, you’ll also be able to monitor the battery level as well as the preheating status. An upgraded 650mAh battery gives you a full day of casual aromatherapy sessions, and the compact size makes this one of the most portable box mods available. With intuitive controls and an easy-to-read display, the Yocan UNI Pro Box Mod is great for both beginners and experienced aromatherapy device users alike to enjoy their favorite pre-filled essential oil, and WELLNESS BLEND sealed extract cartridge on the move.; The Yocan UNI Box Mod Thermal Extractor 🔋; Made for Pre-Filled sealed extract cartridge & Tanks; Fits any Size Oil Tank up to 14mm*. Category: Vape Battery for Cartridges. Brand: Yocan.

item.g:title: Grenco Science G Pen Roam Thermal Extractor
item.g:description: The G Pen Roam delivers water filtration in a portable essential extract thermal extractor that is built to last. An ergonomic design makes carrying the Roam Thermal Extractor easy, and the device houses a glass hydro-tube that purifies and cools your vapor. The quartz tank of the G Pen Roam does a fantastic job of saving your material’s flavor, even with the high-temperature range of 600°F to 800°F. Powered by a 1300mAh lithium-ion battery, the G Pen Roam charges quickly, can be used during the charging process, and stays alive for an entire day of aromatherapy. The G Pen Roam features a full quartz tank with a protective silicone housing that works to bring out your essential extracts' full flavors. Compared to titanium tanks or heating elements, quartz does a much better job of letting you taste your draws and has a much faster heat-up time. The Roam Thermal Extractor gets to temperature quickly due to the quartz tank working in conjunction with the powerful 1300mAh battery. Even with such a high-temperature range, the G Pen Roam will let you taste your material during sessions, delivering a mix of dense clouds and flavorful vapor. Key features: Inside of the Roam’s comfortable housing is their glass hydro-tube water filtration system. The hydro-tube serves as the “vapor path” for the Roam and is attached directly to the mouthpiece. In keeping the hydro-tube so close to the mouthpiece, Grenco Science ensured that you’ll get fresh draws with each pull since your vapor is going directly from the chamber to your lips with no empty space. Each G Pen Roam complete kit comes standard within a hemp travel case with room for two essential extracts jars and a pocket for accessories. This pocket is perfect for traveling with the included micro-USB-to-USB charging cable, loading tool, and cleaning swabs.; Grenco Science G Pen Roam Thermal Extractor; Customized Temperature Control; Enclosed Glass Hydro Tube. Category: Portable Vaporizer. Brand: Grenco Science.

item.g:title: Storz & Bickel Volcano Hybrid Thermal Extractor
item.g:description: From the makers of the world-renowned Volcano Desktop Thermal Extractor comes the Volcano Hybrid, the latest and greatest innovation from Storz & Bickel. Compared to the legendary Volcano Digital Thermal Extractor, the Hybrid boasts a heat-up time that is 10 times faster, an improved airflow system, and a newly designed smartphone app that offers total mastery over your vapor production. Convection heating is paired with precision temperature control to provide a wide array of flavor profiles, while a long-awaited dual-inhalation system now allows you to choose between the classic balloon bag delivery method or convert your new Volcano Hybrid into a whip-style thermal extractor! The innovative dual-inhalation system on the Volcano Hybrid features options for both whip-style inhalation and classic Storz & Bickel reusable balloon bags. Simply fill the included balloon bags with the built-in air pump, or enjoy silent draws directly from the heating chamber using the included whip. Volcano Thermal Extractors are known for their exceptional flavor production and the new whip-style system delivers resistance-free, quiet draws that are even tastier because you pull vapor directly from the heating chamber as opposed to the balloon bag. The Volcano Hybrid Thermal Extractor’s included whip kit was engineered for sharing, designed to eliminate any tangled tubing when passing around. It also has an ergonomic mouthpiece that provides a comfortable, airtight seal every draw. Key features: The Volcano Hybrid Thermal Extractor is equipped with Storz & Bickel’s iconic convection heating system. Instead of heating your materials directly on the hot surface of the loading chamber, the elite heating system propels air through the vapor path using a 100-watt heater. This method extracts optimal flavors from your dry herbs with essentially zero risk of combustion. The Volcano Hybrid always provides smooth vapor that’s easy on the lungs, free of unwanted tastes or odors. Just like its predecessor, this premium desktop unit features a dual-compatible design that will work with both dry herbs and essential oil essential extracts. If you wish to aromatherapy device essential extracts instead, simply insert a liquid drip pad (not included) into the filling chamber and you're good to go! ( The Hybrid Thermal Extractor features its own distinct set of accessories and does not work with the Volcano Liquid Pads that were universal in Storz & Bickel products of the past).; Operating similarly to the Volcano Digital, the Hybrid was fashioned with easy-to-use, integrated touch buttons that help you masterfully execute your aromatherapy device sessions. A bright LED screen displays both your chosen heat setting and the exact temperature of your unit, while simple “+” and “-” buttons allow you to hone in on your ideal temperatures. Storz & Bickel equipped the Volcano Hybrid with an expansive temperature range between 104°F and 446°F to offer a full flavor spectrum and meet any personal preference. A newly engineered smartphone app now allows you to easily manage and control your Hybrid Thermal Extractor directly from your smartphone via Bluetooth compatibility. The app provides you with full control over each session and advanced details about your new desktop unit. Complete with a full suite of compatible Storz & Bickel parts & accessories, the Volcano Hybrid Thermal Extractor has everything you need for a truly enjoyable aromatherapy experience. Whether you prefer the balloon bags of the past or the brand new tube, the Volcano Hybrid sports a first-class design with impressive features and groundbreaking upgrades that are guaranteed to provide you with the same outstanding vapor quality you’ve come to know and love from Storz & Bickel.; Storz & Bickel Volcano Hybrid Thermal Extractor; Whip-Style & Balloon Bag Delivery. Category: Desktop Vaporizer. Brand: Storz & Bickel.

item.g:title: Vapium Lite Thermal Extractor - Black
item.g:description: The Vapium Lite is a portable dry botanical thermal extractor built for adventure. Featuring a pure ceramic heating chamber, the Vapium Lite uses combustion-free technology to efficiently vaporize botanical while extracting more compounds from less material. Thermal-resistant surfaces on the inside vaporize dry botanical beneath the point of combustion to activate material without burning it and deliver you perfect purity. An advanced air path pulls clean air from the outside into the heating chamber for pure-tasting draws while eight optimized temperature settings let you explore a variety of different vaporizing styles. The Vapium Lite also has a built-in stirring tool that allows you to easily mix up your dry herbs between sessions and comes with a universal 14/18mm hydro-vessel adapter that makes it easier than ever to attach your new vapeÂ to your favorite hydro-filtration devices &Â handheld glass pieces. The Vapium Lite Thermal Extractor comes equipped with eight optimized temperature settings that range from 356 Â° F - 446 Â° F. This wide temperature range provides for a wide variety of vapor profiles whether you seek big or small, robust or smooth, and mild or intensely flavored draws. A simple interface lets easily you change temperature settings using "+" and "-" buttons, with LED lights that indicate your current setting. Once you choose your temperature, the Vapium Lite thermal extractor boasts a rapid 30-second heat up time that keeps up with any fast-paced lifestyle. A powerful 1100mAh battery has an extensive battery life to fuel your adventures and vibrations will tell you when the device is ready to use, allowing you to keep the Lite hidden until it's time to aromatherapy device. Key features: The Vapium Lite Thermal Extractor was engineered with a compact & ergonomic design that fits perfectly in your hand and comfortably in your pocket. MadeÂ using the highest quality materials, the Vapium Lite was built to offer maximum durability while still remaining lightweight & travel-friendly. Combining stealthiness, power & simplicity in one pocket-friendly device, the Vapium Lite Thermal Extractor lets you seek, explore, and get lost with the push of a button.; Vapium Lite Handheld Thermal Extractor; Pure Ceramic Heating Chamber; Eight Optimized Heat Settings. Category: Portable Vaporizer. Brand: Vapium.

item.g:title: Yocan UNI - Fully Universal Sealed Extract Cartridge Thermal Extractor - Black/Black
item.g:description: The Yocan UNI Box Mod Thermal Extractor is changing the way you use your pre-filled essential oil & WELLNESS BLEND sealed extract cartridge. Adding an unprecedented higher level of customization to your aromatherapy session experience, the Yocan UNI Aromatherapy Device features an adjustable sealed extract cartridge slot that works with any sized 510-threaded atomizer tank. The Yocan UNI Box Mod Thermal Extractor eliminates the need for multiple aromatherapy device batteries for sealed extract cartridge with different-sized widths. Instead, the UNI was engineered with an innovative slider on the outside of the battery that gives you full control over how far your sealed extract cartridge or atomizer sticks out, and a dial that changes the diameter to fit different tank sizes. The UNI is powered by a 650mAh battery that can be charged on the go with an included micro-USB charger cable. To use the Yocan UNI Aromatherapy Device Battery, simply attach the magnetic 510-threaded adapter to your pre-filled sealed extract cartridge or atomizers, adjust the height & width as needed, and insert your atomizer or sealed extract cartridge for a perfect fit every time. This Yocan Thermal Extractor offers complete temperature control with three variable voltages to give you full mastery over your flavors & cloud size. Fashioned with an advanced preheat function, the Yocan UNI Thermal Extractor will warm up your essential extracts for 10 seconds to deliver smooth & flavorful rips whenever desired. Key features: 510-Threaded Aromatherapy Device Battery 🔋; The Yocan UNI Box Mod Thermal Extractor; Made for Pre-Filled sealed extract cartridge & Tanks; Fits any Size Oil Tank up to 12mm*. Category: Vape Battery for Cartridges. Brand: Yocan.

item.g:description: The O.pen Battery is incredibly versatile yet easy-to-use. An ultra-compact pen-style design enables stealthy aromatherapy sessions on the go while its stylus button controls everything with color-coded lights to display the voltage and battery life. The O.pen Battery 2.0 features four voltage settings, offering complete control over your vapor. With four heat settings, you can explore a variety of experiences from small, flavorful draws, to huge clouds and anything in-between. Each setting is color-coded: Key features: Purple - Low (2.4v); Orange - Medium (3.2v); Green - High (4.0v); Blue - Essential Oil Mode (4.0v). Category: Vape Battery for Cartridges. Brand: O.penVAPE.

item.g:title: Yocan Magneto Essential Oil Thermal Extractor 🍯 - Rasta
item.g:description: The Yocan Magneto Thermal Extractor is an all-in-one essential oil pen with unique characteristics--it features no threading, only powerfully convenient magnetic connections with a built-in, non-stick essential extract jar. A functional coil cap (also magnetically connected) prevents waxy oils from leaking out of the Yocan Magneto aromatherapy device, perfect for the adventure that is on-the-go aromatherapy. The cap features a built-in extract tool so you don't have to carry any extra tools with you. The Yocan Magneto Thermal Extractor boasts an innovative multi-layered ceramic coil that delivers huge clouds and clean draws from your waxy oils. The Yocan Magneto Thermal Extractor is fitted with magnetic connection points between the atomizer tube and the battery, as well as on the coil cap that closes off the essential oil chamber. The Yocan Magneto Thermal Extractor simply snaps together or pulls apart--no screwing necessary--making for a seriously convenient experience that's unique to the Yocan Magneto. Loading and cleaning the atomizer is incredibly easy with the Yocan Magneto Thermal Extractor, making it ideal for aromatherapy about town. Key features: Yocan Magneto Essential Oil Thermal Extractor Pen; Built-In Essential Oil Container & Extract Tool; Multi-layered Ceramic Atomizer; Magnetic Attachments. Category: Vaporizer Pen. Brand: Yocan.

item.g:title: Yocan Evolve Plus Thermal Extractor Pen 🍯 - Midnight
item.g:description: The Yocan Evolve Plus essential oil pen is a sleek, discreet, and high performance essential oil thermal extractor for enjoying essential extracts on-the-go. An upgrade from the original Yocan Evolve aromatherapy device, the Yocan Evolve Plus enjoys a stronger battery and larger essential oil atomizer. The Yocan Evolve Plus aromatherapy device is discreetly sized, making it easy to hide in your pocket or hand. A powerful dual quartz essential oil atomizer, 1100mAh battery with USB charging, and secret non-stick compartment for waxy oils make the Yocan Evolve Plus perfect for aromatherapy on-the-go. Yocan Evolve Plus Thermal Extractor Pen Key features: Upgraded Battery; Built-In Essential Extract Jar; Dual Quartz Coil Atomizer; Larger Chamber. Category: Vaporizer Pen. Brand: Yocan.

item.g:title: Yocan Evolve Plus XL Essential Oil Thermal Extractor - Black
item.g:description: The Yocan Evolve Plus XL Thermal Extractor is an upgrade of the original Evolve Plus aromatherapy device with a stronger battery, adjustable airflow, and an optional hanging ring for easy carrying. The extra powerful quad coil quartz atomizer provides four times the surface area of the average essential oil pen, delivering huge, extract-like clouds while still maintaining a compact and portable experience. A detachable, built-in dual compartment silicone jar enables you to discreetly carry different waxy oils separately as you travel. Pocket-friendly and stealthy, the Yocan Plus XL aromatherapy device puts the power of a extract-desktop filtration apparatus in the palm of your hand. Most aromatherapy device pens feature two heating rods--at the most. The Yocan Evolve Plus XL breaks the mold with a super powerful quad quartz coil atomizer wrapped in titanium. The 100% medical-grade quartz heats essential oils without rubbing off on their essential flavors and aromas and the extra surface area of the quadruple coils produces surprisingly large clouds. A chamber lid keeps essential oil from leaking from the atomizer, a common issue among other aromatherapy device pens, while a magnetic connection between the atomizer tube and base makes loading, cleaning and replacing the atomizer easy. The best part, the Yocan Evolve Plus XL comes with two of these bad boy quad coil quartz atomizers. Key features: Yocan Evolve Plus XL Thermal Extractor Pen; Built-In Dual Compartment Essential Oil Jar; 2 Quad Coil Quartz Atomizers; 100% Medical-Grade Quartz. Category: Vaporizer Pen. Brand: Yocan.

item.g:title: Volcano Classic Desktop Thermal Extractor
item.g:description: The Volcano Classic from German manufacturer Storz & Bickel has been the most popular forced-air desktop thermal extractor on the market since its release over a decade ago. Easily the most recognizable thermal extractor in its class, the Volcano Classic features an iconic volcano-shaped design and an advanced convection heating system. This desktop unit produces pure, potent, and clean-tasting draws that are free of the harmful irritants found in aroma. Vapor from the Volcano Classic is made up of 95% of the active ingredients found in herbs while aroma consists of 88% non-cannabinoids. An easy-to-use rotary dial lets you toggle the temperature range from 1 to 9, allowing you to customize each aromatherapy session to your liking. The Volcano Classic temperature range spans from 266F to 446F, providing a variety of vapor profiles. With the Easy Valve balloon-bag system, the Storz & Bickel Volcano lets you attach a balloon bag to the thermal extractor, fill it up with vapor, and detach with ease. A mouthpiece on the vapor bag makes for easy consumption. Users walk around with the bag completely untethered from the Volcano Classic. Balloons store vapor for up to 8 hours. With long-lasting quality, excellent vapor production, and an easy-to-use design, the Volcano Classic has remained one of the most popular thermal extractors for decades. Key features: The Storz & Bickel Volcano Classic; Includes Easy Valve Starter Set; 3 Year Manufacturer Warranty; Quality German Engineering. Category: Desktop Vaporizer. Brand: Storz & Bickel.

What sets this botanical homogenizer apart from the rest is its FDA-approved ceramic coating which means no more sticking parts or residue build-up. The 2” inch diameter means you’ll have plenty of space to load, grind, and store your favorite herbs. The SLX Medium Ceramic Coat 4-Piece botanical homogenizer has 27 trapezoid-shaped, razor-sharp teeth with perfectly designed drop holes, so no materials get left behind. The ergonomic, comfort-designed grips on SLX botanical homogenizer allow you to grind and twist the plates together with little effort. If you like options, you can adjust the size of your botanical chamber thanks to this botanical homogenizer’s removable screens. On that note, you are also able to choose your botanical homogenizer in a variety of sleek colors. If you want a botanical homogenizer with a clean look and supreme functionality, choose the SLX Medium Ceramic Coated 4-Piece botanical homogenizer! Key features: SLX Medium Ceramic Coated botanical homogenizer; 27 Razor Sharp Grinding Teeth; Non-Stick Ceramic Coating; FDA-Approved Ceramic. Category: Grinder. Brand: SLX Grinders.

item.g:title: Ongrok 2-Piece Metal Botanical Homogenizer - Pink

This botanical homogenizer is made of black colored aluminum and branded with The Kind Pen's official logo on its lid. From top to bottom this botanical homogenizer is perfectly built to grind for a lifetime. Your herbs are broken down with diamond-shaped teeth to finely grind dry herbs within its top level. The top piece of the botanical homogenizer is magnetically connected to the middle piece, while the bottom pollen chamber screws on. This middle section of the botanical homogenizer contains a fixed mesh screen, which sifts minuscule particles of botanical into the pollen chamber. This botanical homogenizer also includes a pollen scraper, so you can easily gather your finer particles of botanical. item.g:title: SharpStone V2 Hard Top 2.5" 4-Piece Botanical Homogenizer - Black
item.g:description: Meet the newest botanical homogenizer from SharpStone! This redesigned 4-piece botanical homogenizer provides you with the same great features of the original SharpStone botanical homogenizer with some modest design upgrades. The Version 2 Sharpstone botanical homogenizer is made from aircraft grade aluminum, using the latest in CNC machining technology and anodized for a smooth finish. The inside of this large botanical homogenizer features razor sharp grinding teeth made for shredding your dry herbs into the perfect aromatherapy session consistency. As you twist the botanical homogenizer plates together, your materials will be deposited into the middle chamber. This chamber is equipped with a stainless steel pollen screen so that only the finest kief can pass through and collect within the base compartment. Every SharpStone V2 botanical homogenizer includes a pollen scraper tool in the base chamber for managing your goods. The SharpStone V2 Hard Top botanical homogenizer is complete with powerful neodymium magnets that firmly secure the top lid when on the move. A thin poly ring lines this section and was engineered to provide a smooth, frictionless grind each use. Every SharpStone botanical homogenizer features an engraved serial number for authenticity and arrives in a protective, reusable pouch. Available in a variety of flashy colors, the SharpStone V2 4-Piece botanical homogenizer is fully prepared to add some style to your stash of aromatherapy session accessories while providing you with a fully-functional, hassle-free grinding experience. Key features: SharpStone V2 Hard Top botanical homogenizer; Aircraft Grade Aluminum Body; Stainless Steel Pollen Screen; Razor Sharp Grinding Teeth. Category: Grinder. Brand: SharpStone.

With 510 thread compatibility, this thermal extractor offers true versatility no matter how you prefer to consume. Additionally, the Flow features four customizable heat settings (2.5V, 3.0V, 3.5V, 4.0V), giving you the flexibility to tailor each session. The Zenco Flow stands out with its automatic filling mechanism and instant heat-up technology. The glass components are dishwasher safe, making maintenance simple, while the removable food-grade silicone diffuser ensures a clean and pure vapor path. All Zenco glassware is interchangeable. Whether you break it, or just want to change up the design, your Flow can connect with any of our glassware attachments. Currently available in both Wood and Onyx finishes. item.g:title: Titanium Tip: Helix
item.g:description: The Helix Titanium Tip puts a new twist on design. With an elevated, triple helix design, this tip is both lightweight and cool, especially when it comes to heat transfer. The Helix is our lightest tip yet, weighing just over 3 grams. We removed mass and created more surface area (where the traditional fins are), further reducing heat transfer to the stem. Thicker chamber walls help to even out the roast and reduce hot spots. The 3 convection ports, combined with machined internal channels, assist with quick and even vapor extraction. The CCD can be positioned to adjust the chamber from full to half size, which is perfect for micro-dosing. item.g:title: Zenco Duo - Black
item.g:description: The Zenco Duo Thermal Extractor is a state-of-the-art device that brings social aromatherapy to a new level. Designed for versatility, the Duo is compatible with 510 thread sealed extract cartridge, dry herbs, and essential extracts, making it a perfect choice for a variety of aromatherapy preferences. This thermal extractor features automatic filling and instant heat-up technology, ensuring that your sessions start quickly and smoothly. The Zenco Duo includes two high-quality glass attachments, allowing for simultaneous use, which makes it ideal for sharing with friends. With four adjustable heat settings (2.5V, 3.0V, 3.5V, 4.0V), you can customize your experience to get the exact vapor density and flavor you prefer. In addition to its advanced functionality, the Zenco Duo comes with essential accessories, including two vapor coils, a USB charger, a essential extract scoop, and a cleaning brush, ensuring you have everything you need for a premium aromatherapy session right out of the box. Available in sleek finishes like Onyx, Wood, Leaf, and Stone, the Zenco Duo not only performs excellently but also adds a touch of style to your setup. Backed by a 1-year limited warranty, the Zenco Duo Thermal Extractor is a reliable and elegant choice for anyone looking to elevate their aromatherapy experience, whether solo or shared.
